title: Bilmekaniker / teknisk leder – Bil, ATV og UTV
description:
Senteret AS i Egersund søker teknisk leder / bilmekaniker for lette kjøretøy. Hos oss får du en variert arbeidshverdag med bil, ATV/UTV, dekk, og noe anleggsmaskiner – kombinert med stor frihet, ansvar og mulighet til å forme din egen arbeidsdag.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter en dyktig og engasjert bilmekaniker som ønsker å ta ansvar og være med på å bygge opp vårt nye bilverksted.

Du liker å finne løsninger, jobber selvstendig og trives med en variert arbeidshverdag. Hos oss er ikke alle dager like, så vi ser etter en person som synes det er spennende å jobbe med alt fra moderne biler og diagnose til ATV/UTV, tilhengere og andre mekaniske utfordringer.

Vi ser gjerne at du:

  • Har fagbrev som bilmekaniker for lette kjøretøy

  • Har relevant praksis og kan oppfylle kravene til teknisk leder, eller allerede er godkjent som teknisk leder

  • Er selvstendig, løsningsorientert og tar initiativ

  • Har god teknisk forståelse og interesse for feilsøking

  • Er strukturert og opptatt av kvalitet i arbeidet

  • Tar ansvar for jobben fra den kommer inn til den er ferdig

  • Trives med både selvstendig arbeid og samarbeid med andre

  • Har lyst til å bidra med egne ideer til hvordan verkstedet kan utvikles

Erfaring med ATV/UTV eller anleggsmaskiner er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Det viktigste for oss er å finne riktig person. Du trenger derfor ikke kunne <<alt>> fra første dag. Har du riktig faglig grunnlag, praktisk sans og lyst til å utvikle både deg selv og verkstedet sammen med oss, ønsker vi gjerne å høre fra deg.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som teknisk leder og bilmekaniker får du en sentral rolle i oppbyggingen og den daglige driften av vårt nye bilverksted. Du får stor påvirkning på hvordan verkstedet organiseres og utvikles.

Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet være:

  • Service, vedlikehold, feilsøking og reparasjon av person- og varebiler

  • Teknisk ledelse og oppfølging av verksteddriften

  • Sikre at arbeid utføres i henhold til gjeldende krav og rutiner

  • Kontroll og kvalitetssikring av utført arbeid

  • Bidra til å utvikle gode rutiner og effektiv arbeidsflyt i verkstedet

  • Montering, Service og reparasjoner på ATV/UTV

  • Dekk- og hjularbeid

  • Mulighet for arbeid på mindre anleggs- og arbeidsmaskiner

Dette er en stilling for deg som liker variasjon og ønsker større frihet til å kunne styre din egen arbeidsdag. Siden bilverkstedet etableres nå, får du en unik mulighet til å være med og forme både verkstedet, utstyrsparken og arbeidshverdagen fra starten.

Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr en variert og selvstendig arbeidshverdag med stor frihet og korte beslutningsveier. Som teknisk leder blir du en viktig del av satsingen vår på bilverksted, og får være med på å forme verkstedet fra starten.

Hos oss får du blant annet:

  • Konkurransedyktig lønn etter avtale

  • Fast 100 % stilling eller deltidsstilling, alt etter hva som passer deg best.

  • Stor grad av frihet og ansvar i arbeidshverdagen

  • Reell påvirkning på hvordan verkstedet bygges opp og drives

  • Mulighet til å påvirke valg av verktøy, utstyr og arbeidsmetoder

  • En svært variert arbeidshverdag med bil, ATV/UTV, dekk, og maskiner

  • Muligheter for kurs, faglig utvikling og videre kompetanse

  • Et uformelt arbeidsmiljø med korte beslutningsveier

  • En arbeidsplass i utvikling, hvor gode ideer raskt kan bli satt ut i praksis

Vi ønsker at den som kommer inn i denne rollen skal få være med på å utvikle det videre sammen med oss. Her får du muligheten til å sette ditt eget preg på arbeidsplassen -- ikke bare overta en ferdig oppskrift.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Senteret AS er en lokal og solid bedrift i Egersund med en variert virksomhet innen kjøretøy, maskiner og utstyr. Vi driver blant annet med salg og service av ATV/UTV, dekk og hjul gjennom Dekkpartner, samt utleie i samarbeid med Naboen Utleie.

Vi liker å ha flere bein å stå på og har bygget virksomheten rundt praktiske løsninger, god service og korte beslutningsveier.

Hos oss er det høyt under taket, lite unødvendig byråkrati og kort vei fra en god idé til handling. Vi ønsker å bygge et moderne og allsidig verksted hvor både ansatte og kunder skal trives, og hvor den rette personen får stor påvirkning på hvordan verkstedet utvikles videre.

title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the interaction between information systems and machine learning
description:
About the position

We invite applications for a Postdoctoral Research Fellow position in action-oriented modeling for trustworthy AI, available at the Department of Informatics, University of Oslo.

The starting date is no later than 01.03.2027 and as soon as possible after the appointment.

The appointment is a full-time position for a period of three years.

The fellowship is funded in full by TRUST for the whole period. No teaching, supervision, or research-assistance duties are required in the position, and the fellowship period can therefore not be extended to four years on that basis.

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Research Fellowship at the University of Oslo.

The place of work is the Department of Informatics at the University of Oslo. The successful candidate will be part of the daily research and social life of TRUST – the Norwegian Centre for Trustworthy AI, and of the information systems research group.


Project description

The position is funded by TRUST, the Norwegian Centre for Trustworthy AI, which is a research centre dedicated to developing trustworthy AI systems that are accurate, fair, transparent, safe, and well-governed. The centre brings together researchers from computational and data science, law, social sciences, and philosophy to develop new AI technologies and study their societal impact in areas such as healthcare, industry, governance, security, and climate. TRUST is led by University of Oslo, SINTEF, and Norwegian Computing Center. With a consortium of over 70 partners from academia, industry, government, and civil society in Norway and internationally, TRUST’s research is theoretical, methodological, legal, and empirical in nature.

The postdoc will conduct the research project Action-Oriented Modeling for Trustworthy AI in Practice. The project addresses a persistent problem in applied AI: statistically accurate models routinely fail when they meet the organizations and ecosystems meant to use them. Models are misaligned with local procedures and decision processes, too rigid for resource-constrained operational systems, and opaque to the decision-makers who must act based on them. We treat this as a methodological problem rather than a technical one.

The primary deliverable of this position is a theoretical and methodological template that we call Action-Oriented Modeling. Rather than delivering finished algorithms, the template specifies how to build deliberately context-agnostic model architectures that expose methodological choices as parameters, and how local actors then configure, tune, and operate them. Its novelty lies in integrating three dimensions normally treated separately: configurable architectures that let domain experts shape model behavior without machine learning expertise; iterative field validation inside operational workflows; and governance mechanisms that transfer model ownership to local users.

The successful candidate will lead the development of this template into a generic, transferable, and theoretically grounded contribution. Your main tasks are to:

  • Develop, formalize, and publish the Action-Oriented Modeling template. This is the central output
  • Validate the template empirically through an action research design approach supplemented by participatory design methods
  • Define governance principles for model ownership that let stakeholders revise models as operational contexts change
  • Coordinate collaboration between the core development team, implementation partners, and local stakeholders, and act as a competence hub for action-oriented AI across TRUST

Two contrasting cases provide the empirical ground. The primary case is climate-sensitive disease prediction supporting public health decisions in low- and middle-income countries, built on DHIS2 and the action research network of the Health Information Systems Programme (HISP), with national health teams in ten countries. The complementary case is KoSy, the DHIS2-based municipal surveillance platform run by the Norwegian Institute of Public Health. We seek a candidate motivated by the methodological contribution to these and other empirical settings.

The main purpose of a postdoctoral fellowship is to provide candidates with enhanced skills to pursue a scientific top position within or beyond academia. To promote a strategic career path, all postdoctoral research fellows are required to submit a professional development plan no later than one month after commencement of the postdoctoral period.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in information systems, informatics, computer science, science and technology studies, or another relevant field. The applicant must document that the degree corresponds to the requirement. The doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and public defense are eventually eligible for appointment
  • Documented experience with engaged, qualitative research methods in organizational settings, such as action research, design science research, or participatory design
  • Documented ability to publish conceptual, theoretical, or methodological contributions in high-ranking peer-reviewed journals or conferences
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

Desired qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience conducting sociotechnical research on information systems, examining how technology, people, and organizational contexts interact
  • Understanding of machine learning and predictive modeling sufficient to engage critically and constructively with data scientists, for example on data quality and model assumptions
  • Technical skills sufficient to deploy and test models

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

In terms of personal skills:

  • You are motivated by methodological questions, enjoy qualitative fieldwork, and are excited about the academic challenge of turning messy empirical data into clear theoretical contributions
  • You work well both independently and as part of an interdisciplinary team, and you communicate across the boundary between technical and institutional expertise
  • You collaborate respectfully and effectively with practitioners and decision-makers who are not researchers
  • You work in a professional and structured manner and adapt quickly to new tasks
  • You are dependable and high-performing, also in hectic periods
  • You prefer being present at work and contribute actively to the professional and social environment you are part of

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • A position at the centre of a national research effort on trustworthy AI, with access to the TRUST network and to operational partners in ten countries
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Postdoctoral development programmes.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK 595 000 - 690 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter, stating your motivation, summarizing your scientific work, and describing your research interests. The cover letter should not be written with the help of AI
  • A research statement of no more than three pages, setting out how you would approach the development and validation of the Action-Oriented Modeling template. The statement must connect clearly to the development of the template, and it is the main basis on which the evaluation committee will assess your fit for the position
  • CV summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience, and other qualifying activity
  • Copies of educational certificates and academic transcript of records
  • A complete list of publications and up to 5 academic works that you wish to be considered by the evaluation committee. Please link these 5 publications, do not send them, except if they are still in manuscript format
  • Names and contact details of 2 to 3 references, with name, relation to candidate, e-mail, and telephone number

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

Please see the guidelines and regulations for appointments to Postdoctoral fellowships at the University of Oslo.

If an applicant has applied for and been granted funding for a fulltime research stay abroad while being employed as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, the employment will be prolonged with the equivalent time as the research stay, but for no longer than of twelve months ( thus extending the employment to a maximum of four years).

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results a.o.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Informatics (IFI) is one of nine departments belonging to the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. IFI is Norway’s largest university department for general education and research in Computer Science and related topics. 

The Department has more than 1800 students on bachelor level, 600 master students, and over 240 PhDs and postdocs. The overall staff of the Department is close to 370 employees, about 280 of these in full time positions. The full time tenured academic staff is 75, mostly Full/Associate Professors.

title: PhD Candidate in Human-Centred Design for AI Companionship and Care in Ageing Societies
employer: NTNU FAKULTET FOR ARKITEKTUR OG DESIGN
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The Department of Design at NTNU invites applications for a fully funded PhD position within the Human-Centred Artificial Intelligence (HCAI) Lab at NTNU Gjøvik. The position offers an opportunity to conduct mixed method research, applying human-centred design methods and Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) perspectives to investigate how AI companionship technologies may reshape experiences of care, companionship, emotional support, wellbeing, and autonomy among older adults.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


About the project

Many countries are experiencing demographic changes associated with ageing populations, increasing pressure on healthcare systems and growing concerns regarding social isolation and loneliness among older adults. A large body of research shows that this, in turn, can pose severe risks to their physical and mental health, eroding community social resilience and impacting quality of life – as well as longevity in general. 

At the same time, advances in AI have led to the development of conversational agents, AI companions, and socially assistive technologies designed to provide social and emotional support while removing barriers like accessibility and stigma. Within this context, the PhD candidate will contribute to developing conceptual and functional prototypes that explore alternative futures for AI companionship and care using action-oriented, empathy-driven, and inclusive design methods. 


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Research on why and how AI companionship can address challenges of ageing population
  • Engage in developing, testing, and evaluating prototypes in-house as well as with external stakeholders
  • Take part in both scientific and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in the HCAI Lab and relevant research networks
  • Be involved in international activities, such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
  • Teaching
  • Other career-promoting work 

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must have a master's degree in design or a related field
  • You must have a strong interest in human-centred AI and the societal implications of AI technologies
  • You must have experience with building prototypes
  • You must have experience with qualitative methods and/or mixed methods
  • Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at the master's level. Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position and no later than 15th of July 2027.
  • You must have an average grade from your master's degree studies, or equivalent education, which is equal to a B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you may be considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme
  • You must have good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language equivalent to level B2, as well as excellent written and oral communication skills in English

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Experience conducting user-oriented studies, such as interviews, workshops, or co-design activities
  • Knowledge of accessibility, universal and inclusive design, ageing, wellbeing, healthcare technologies, or welfare technologies
  • Dissemination of research in relevant venues

Personal characteristics

We seek a PhD candidate who is:

  • Curious, open-minded, and motivated to explore innovative HCAI solutions
  • Able to work independently and collaboratively
  • Interested in combining theory, research, and design practice
  • Enthusiastic about connecting with people and engaging with real-world societal challenges
  • Willing to contribute to a positive work atmosphere

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 4 years for the doctoral work 12 months of career promotion work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in [subject area] (link to possible website)within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English. (decide on this - remove if not applicable)

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Cover letter describing motivation for the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Copies of academic transcripts and diplomas
  • Master's thesis (or equivalent major research project)
  • Publications and other scholarly work (if applicable)
  • Portfolio demonstrating design, prototyping, or research work (if applicable)
  • Research Vision Statement (maximum two pages, excluding references)
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Anne Britt Torkildsby, +47 90193130, anne.torkildsby@ntnu.no, Associate Professor Yavuz Inal, +47 41301855,  yavuz.inal@ntnu.no or Postdoctoral Fellow Sujay Shalawadi, sujay.shalawadi@ntnu.no.

title: Tenure-track position in Archaeology
description:
About the position 

A tenure-track position (tenure-track in a postdoctoral position and tenured as associate professor) in Archaeology is available at The Department of Archaeology, Conservation and History (IAKH), University of Oslo. IAKH comprises the three disciplinary fields of archaeology conservation and history. The archaeology section has nine academic faculty positions, each with teaching and research components. The section’s research profile and teaching program are internationally oriented and span archaeologies of the Stone Age to the present. The announced position is focused on GIS, statistics and Mesolithic archaeology in Scandinavia.

The announced tenure-track position starts as a full-time postdoctoral position (SKO 1352) for a period of six years, including a 25 % component devoted to teaching and administrative duties. These duties include obtaining basic pedagogical qualifications. A formal midterm evaluation will be held in the fourth year of this period, and the candidate will receive feedback on performance relative to the requirements for the six-year tenure-track period. Toward the end of the six-year period, the candidate will be evaluated for a tenured position as associate professor (SKO 1011). During the final assessment, the candidate’s research performance will first be assessed by an expert (adjudication) committee within the candidate’s subject area. Subsequently, the candidate will be interviewed by an internal interview committee assessing the full range of criteria in the contract of employment.


More about the position 

Applicants apply with a research project including GIS, statistics and the Mesolithic in Scandinavia to be carried out in the initial six years period. In the application letter, candidates should also describe long term plans for building an international research group, for future development of the teaching in Stone Age Archaeology, for contributing to the public dissemination of research, and for developing their own academic career. 

The contract of employment will specify results, requirements, and criteria regarding academic production, public dissemination, research leadership and teaching that the candidate must fulfil during the six-years period to be favourably evaluated for a tenured position. According to the Regulations on appointments to tenure-track positions, with supplementary provisions for UiO, the contract of employment will also specify the criteria for the midterm and final assessment of competencies and milestones. Candidates will also be evaluated on personal suitability and ability to contribute to academic citizenship, both during the initial hiring process and during the mid-term and final evaluations. The contract of employment will further outline the Department’s obligations in supporting the candidate’s research as well as offering academic mentorship, guidance and training. 

Make sure to follow the description of required results necessary in order to be eligible for the tenured position as associate professor.


Requirements 
  • PhD or equivalent academic qualifications within archaeology of the Mesolithic in Scandinavia, with a clear profile in GIS and statistical analysis, granted within the past five years (excluding documented parental and sickness leaves) 
  • Thorough knowledge of the material culture of the Mesolithic in Scandinavia 
  • Demonstrated ability to handle large datasets, geographical information systems and theoretical perspectives on archaeological methodology/practice 
  • Experience in handling of archaeological data using high-end digital tools for quantitative and/or qualitative analysis 
  • Experience with interdisciplinary research approaches within the environmental humanities and/or crossing over to natural sciences 
  • Documented pedagogical skills (either a teaching course certificate or based on teaching experience), see how to document your pedagogical skills 
  • Documented potential for project acquisition • Interest and ability in leadership and administration 
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English and a Scandinavian language 
  • Personal suitability and motivation for the position 

To be eligible, candidates must have submitted for final evaluation or defended their doctoral dissertation within five years preceding the application deadline. In the former case, the appointment will be contingent upon the successful defence of the thesis. Someone who has been employed for more than one year in an ordinary postdoctoral position at the University of Oslo cannot be employed in a postdoctoral position on tenure-track terms.


In the evaluation of the applications, emphasis will be placed on:
  • The research project’s scientific merit and contribution to GIS-based and statistical approaches to the Mesolithic in Scandinavia, including the applicant’s academic and personal ability to carry out the project 
  • The applicant’s long-term plans for building and leading an international research group and successfully join in academic collaboration within and across disciplines, including plans for obtaining external research funding 
  • Academic qualifications and academic production. Originality and quality of publications will be weighted more heavily than quantity 
  • Interest in and motivation for teaching, ability to inspire and provide guidance to students, and potential to teach university-level courses about Stone Age Archaeology and within Archaeology more generally 
  • Interest and ability in leadership and administration, including collaborative skillsExperience with and potential for popular dissemination and public outreach 
  • Academic citizenship, personal suitability and potential to contribute to a positive working environment and the long-term development of teaching and research at the Department 

In the evaluation of the qualified candidates the full range of these criteria will be explicitly addressed and assessed. Academic quality, development, potential and breadth will be prioritised in this order. 

The appointed candidate should demonstrate mastery of both English and one of the Scandinavian languages as working languages.


We can offer you 
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK from 595 000 to 677 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


Application

Your application must include: 

  • Application letter describing the applicant’s qualifications and motivation for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (including list of education, previous and current positions, teaching experience, administrative experience, and other qualifying activities) 
  • List of publications 
  • Project description (3 - 5 pages, maximum 14,000 characters. See Template for project descriptions) 
  • A realistic progress plan for all six years, including activities beyond the postdoctoral research project itself, such as teaching, professional development and project development 
  • Two writing samples (e.g. two chapters from the PhD dissertation or two academic articles) 
  • Copies of educational certificates 

Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language), either in the original or in translation. 

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system, jobbnorge.no. Applicants with education from non-Norwegian universities must attach an explanation of their grading systems.


Selection procedure

As the first step in the evaluation process, a Selection Committee will assess all applications and invite the most qualified applicants to submit a teaching portfolio and academic works (up to 7 publications) for expert assessment. Academic texts, except for the two writing samples, shall therefore not be enclosed with the initial application. Applicants who are invited to submit academic works are asked to select three works, published within the last 5 years, to be considered as most relevant for the position. In longer publications (monographs), applicants should specify the most relevant pages. Applicants are also asked to submit a teaching portfolio of 3-6 pages documenting educational certificates, competence and experience, including a reflection note in which your own practice and learning vision is anchored in the principles of Scholarship of Teaching and Learning (SoTL). 

Finally, the most highly ranked candidates will be invited for at least one interview and trial lecture. Ranked candidates will be asked to provide a list of 3 reference persons (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number). References are contacted after the interviews.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of archaeology, conservation and history (IAKH) is comprised of three disciplines which in different ways study the past.The department has internationally oriented archaeologists, the only conservation program in Norway and the biggest group of historians in Scandinavia. The department has close to 100 employees, including non-permanent research fellows. The study programs span archaeology from the Stone Age to the Middle Ages, object and paintings conservation, and history from Antiquity to the present age.

description:
Join our team of Fulfillment Operators at Lier!

At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. First, we built Norway’s leading online grocery store, and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective retail system, delivering to thousands of Scandinavian doorsteps every week.

At Oda, you’ll work in a fast-paced, inclusive environment with passionate colleagues who value collaboration and learning. As a Fulfillment Operator, you’ll play a key role in picking and delivering high-quality groceries to the right customer. Together, we tackle operational challenges, support each other, and help shape Oda as a great place to work💪🏼


What you’ll be doing

  • Pick and pack goods for customers

  • Be the first point of contact for the handover of goods from suppliers

  • Ensure that products are on the shelves and that the workplace is kept tidy

  • Work closely with your team to achieve our operational goals and measure against company KPI´s

  • Contribute to a culture that works with continuous improvement of processes and working methods


What you’ll need to succeed🌟

  • Like working as part of a team towards a common goal and are keen to help others

  • See solutions rather than problems and offer suggestions for improvement where necessary

  • Are comfortable with and like routine-based tasks

  • Are motivated by working in a fast-paced, physically active environment

  • Are self-driven and enjoy taking ownership of tasks

  • Have a genuine desire to work and grow in Oda

  • Speak and understand English. Norwegian is a plus

  • The minimum age requirement for this position is 18 years


What would be nice to have💡

  • Previous experience in warehouse work, in a value chain, trade, or production

  • It's a plus if you have a forklift certificate

  • Being service-minded and customer-focused

  • Having your own car or being able to drive is great, as our working hours don't align well with public transportation


What we offer🚀

This is your chance to make a real impact at a fast-moving company with a product people love—while shaking up the grocery industry. You’ll experience:

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, which means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere.

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop—less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • Discounted lunch and a free gym to keep you fuelled and energised 🏋

  • Free parking

  • Oda Shuttle Bus: We offer a shuttle bus service for all employees between Lørenskog (Solheimveien) ➔ Helsfyr ➔ Sjølyst/Skøyen ➔ Lier 🚌


Practical informationℹ️

  • We are currently hiring for both day and night shifts.

    • Working hours:

      • Day shift: 06:30:-14:30

      • Night shift: 22:00-06:00

      • You are going to follow a fixed schedule with a shift rotation, working every fourth weekend

  • We're hiring for our Dry and Cold departments. You’ll primarily work in one department, but assist in the others when needed. Please specify in your application which department you're applying for

  • Application deadline: 6 November. We're actively looking for the right person to join our team, so we’ll be interviewing candidates on a rolling basis. Because we might close the ad early if we find the perfect fit, make sure to get your application in as soon as possible

  • Location: Drammensveien 189, 3420 Lierskogen


A few final words

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job🧡


Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium. As part of our work to ensure a fair and open-minded recruitment process, we have chosen to collaborate with Hubert.ai, a virtual recruitment assistant that helps with the selection process. As soon as you submit an application for this position, you will be invited via email to a chat-based interview. Therefore, be careful to enter your correct email address so the invitation reaches the right place🤖


We look forward to hearing from you🧡

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

title: Department Manager Interior
description:
At VARD, we create innovative and sustainable solutions for the global maritime industry. Combining future-oriented engineering excellence, cutting-edge technology, and strong teamwork, we design and build some of the world’s most advanced vessels for a wide range of market segments, including offshore energy, naval, fisheries, icebreaking and research. 

At the same time, we believe our people are our greatest strength.  We need people with a wide range of skills, professional backgrounds, and experience. Engineers, designers, skilled workers, project managers, finance professionals, procurement specialists and many others all work together towards a common goal. Different perspectives and areas of expertise are essential to delivering high-quality vessels. 

To be able to build the ships of tomorrow today, we foster an inclusive and supportive environment where talents can grow, ideas are valued, and individuals are empowered to make an impact. 

 

Vard Interiors is a leading supplier of turnkey interior, insulation, piping, and HVAC-R solutions for the maritime industry. As part of the VARD value chain, we work closely with shipowners, designers, and shipyards to create functional, sustainable, and high-quality onboard environments. With a strong focus on innovation, craftsmanship, and customer value, we help bring some of the industry’s most advanced vessels to life.

We are currently looking for a Department Manager Interior to join our team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to apply your expertise, collaborate with skilled colleagues, and contribute to exciting projects across the VARD value chain.

Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities

In this role, you will:

  • Lead and support Production Coordinators and Supervisors across projects.
  • Drive operational performance, productivity, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
  • Monitor project progress, resource utilization, quality, and efficiency. 
  • Ensure compliance with HSE requirements and promote a strong safety culture.
  • Collaborate with Project Management, Engineering, Procurement, and installation teams to secure successful project execution. 
  • Resolve operational challenges and support the delivery of projects according to quality, schedule, and budget objectives. 
  • Contribute to planning, performance reporting, and development of the Interior department
Qualifications
  • Relevant technical education or equivalent industry experience.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience within interior shipbuilding.
  • Leadership experience and strong people management skills.
  • Strong operational, planning, and resource management capabilities.
  • Good understanding of HSE, quality, and project execution.
  • Technical understanding of interior installation and production processes.
  • Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

 

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Strong leadership and communication skills.
  • Team-oriented and collaborative approach.
  • Proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Results-oriented with a focus on quality, safety, and efficiency.
  • Ability to motivate, coach, and develop employees.
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
Why you'll enjoy working at VARD

 At VARD, you'll join an international company where innovation, collaboration, and continuous development are part of everyday work. We are committed to creating an environment where people thrive, grow, and succeed together. 

As part of our team, you'll benefit from: 

  • Exciting and meaningful work in a global maritime environment 
  • Opportunities for continuous learning, professional development, and career growth 
  • A competitive pension scheme and comprehensive insurance coverage 
  • Flexible working arrangements, including the possibility to work from home 
  • Subsidized lunch in our office canteen 
  • Subsidized gym membership to support your health and wellbeing 
  • Occupational health services 
  • Free mobile phone usage 
  • Modern office facilities with free parking 

At VARD, we also know that a great workplace is about more than just work. Through Social by VARD, you'll have the opportunity to connect with colleagues across teams and locations through a wide range of social activities and events. From fjord cruises, hiking, and cooking classes to football practice, go-karting, and wine tasting, there are plenty of opportunities to build relationships, share experiences, and create lasting memories.

title: Kundebehandler søkes til bilutleie
description:
Vi søker en serviceinnstilt kundebehandler til et engasjement innen bilutleie. Stillingen passer for deg som trives med direkte kundekontakt, har god struktur og liker en variert arbeidshverdag der ingen dager er like.

Arbeidsoppgaver:
  • Betjening av kunder i skranke, per telefon og på e-post
  • Salg av leieavtaler og rådgivning rundt produkter og tjenester
  • Diverse backoffice-oppgaver knyttet til reservasjoner, fakturering og rapportering
Vi ser etter deg som har følgende kvalifikasjoner og egenskaper:
  • Gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter på norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Serviceinnstilling og evne til å skape trygghet og gode kunderelasjoner
  • Ryddig arbeidsform og evne til å håndtere flere arbeidsoppgaver samtidig
  • Førerkort klasse B og praktisk erfaring med bil er en fordel
  • Grunnleggende datakunnskaper og erfaring med bookingsystemer er ønskelig
Vi tror du er en som: 
  • Trives med utstrakt kundekontakt og setter stolthet i å skape trygghet og gode relasjoner.
  • Liker salg og er en kremmer som ser muligheter i hvert møte med kunden.
  • Takler til tider høyt tempo og klarer å håndtere flere baller i luften samtidig med et smil.

Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktige betingelser, grundig opplæring og et trivelig arbeidsmiljø med varierte og spennende arbeidsoppgaver. Stillingen er et engasjement gjennom bemanningsbyrå, med gode muligheter for faglig utvikling og et tett samarbeid med vår oppdragsgiver.

Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg som brenner for kundeservice, har interesse for bilbransjen og ønsker å bidra til gode kundeopplevelser hver dag

Av hensyn til GDPR kan vi kun motta søknader via stillingsannonsen. Har du spørsmål om stillingen, ta gjerne kontakt med Kjell Øivind Sørby på telefon 959 18 477 eller e-post kjell@bemanningsxperten.no.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vi er en mellomstor aktør innen bemanning og rekruttering i Norge. Vi tilbyr skreddersydde løsninger for både arbeidsgivere og jobbsøkere, med fokus på kvalitet, fleksibilitet og langsiktige samarbeid. Med kontorer i Oslo, Bergen, Kristiansand, Arendal og Rogaland, har vi et sterkt nettverk og gode relasjoner i bransjen. Vårt mål er å matche de rette kandidatene med de riktige stillingene.

I Bemanningsxperten jobber vi verdibasert, og setter samfunnsengasjement, vidsyn og mangfold høyt. Vi utfordrer og er dedikert til å finne kandidater som er opptatt av å skape resultater, arbeidsplasser og verdier. Bemanningsxperten har 16 ansatte fordelt på 5 byer i Norge. Alle har relevant erfaring og bidrar med et stort nettverk.

Vi er Bemanningsxperten – vårt navn forplikter

Våre verdier: Dedikert – Pålitelig – Respekt

Se vår hjemme side for mer info.

title: Elektriker
description:
Vil du være med og sikre at noen av regionens viktigste bygg fungerer hver eneste dag?

Stavanger kommune forvalter distriktets største og mest varierte eiendomsportefølje – fra skoler, barnehager og helsebygg til kulturbygg, bydelshus og historiske eiendommer i gamle Stavanger. Hos oss får du jobbe med en av landets mest spennende bygningsporteføljer, i et fagmiljø som stadig vokser i takt med økende tekniske krav.

Seksjon Byggdrift, som ligger under Bymiljø og utbygging (avdeling Eiendom), består av enhetene Renhold, Drift, Fag og Bolig. Seksjonen har ansvar for daglig drift og vedlikehold av kommunens bygg og boliger, og jobber tett opp mot brukere, tjenester og kommunens øvrige fagmiljøer.

Nå styrker vi laget og søker deg som har teknisk kompetanse, serviceinnstilling og et ønske om å bidra til trygge og godt fungerende bygg for innbyggere og ansatte.

Hos oss vil du få muligheten til å:

  • Arbeide i et fagmiljø med sterk kompetanse og høy aktivitet
  • Bidra til kvalitet, framdrift og godt samarbeid på tvers av fag
  • Sikre at oppdrag blir utført med riktig kvalitet, koordinering og dokumentasjon
  • Følge opp tekniske installasjoner, drift, avvik og servicearbeid
  • Sørge for at lover, forskrifter og interne standarder blir etterlevd
  • Skape gode opplevelser for brukere, ansatte, samarbeidspartnere og oppdragsgivere

Vi ser etter deg som ønsker å jobbe i et profesjonelt miljø med stort ansvar og tydelig samfunnsnytte. Her er det rom for utvikling, spesialisering og å være med på å forme framtidens kommunale byggdrift.  


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Kvalitetssikre avvik og utbedre feil/ mangler
  • Utførelse av arbeidsoppgaver for Fagenheten
  • Reparasjon og test i verkstedavdeling
  • Være en god kollega, være åpen, inkluderende og aktivt ivareta arbeidsmiljø 
  • Utvikling av fagområder
  • Ansvar for at oppgaver gjennomføres/ dokumenteres iht. gjeldene lover og forskrifter
  • Være en rollemodell
  • Aktivt delta i utvikling og forbedring
  • Utstrakt samarbeid med fagleder, faggruppene og virksomhetene
  • Rapportere til Gruppeleder
  • Dele kompetanse og læring  
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Fagarbeider skal ha fagbrev som elektriker Gr.L
  • Førerkort klasse B, fordel med BE

Arbeidsspråket i Stavanger kommune er norsk. Dersom du har et annet morsmål enn norsk, må du dokumentere at du har språkferdigheter tilsvarende B1. Gjelder ikke søkere med et skandinavisk språk som morsmål. 

Personlige egenskaper
  • Du er nær og inkluderende, tar vare på dine kolleger, samarbeidspartnere og innbyggernes behov
  • Du er åpen for andres kunnskap, ønsker å lære og deler av din kunnskap
  • Du er nyskapende og utviklingsorientert, utforsker nye muligheter og løsninger, tør å prøve og feile, evner å forandre for å forbedre
  • Du er profesjonell og har gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner
  • Du er selvstendig og strukturert, løsningsorientert og tenker helhetlig på tvers av sektorer og fag
  • Du har gjennomføringskraft og evner å prioritere
  • Du har god IT-kompetanse og systemforståelse
  • Du har fokus på kvalitet, bærekraftige løsninger og gode økonomiske resultater 
Vi tilbyr
  • Varierte og meningsfulle prosjekter i en av regionens mest spennende og komplekse eiendomsporteføljer
  • Et sterkt og støttende fagmiljø der vi løfter hverandre, deler kompetanse og spiller hverandre gode
  • Stor grad av selvstendighet kombinert med ansvarsfulle og utviklende arbeidsoppgaver
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med kolleger som har solid erfaring, høy faglighet og et ekte engasjement for bygg og tekniske tjenester
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger gjennom KLP
  • Arbeidstid etter avtale
  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter, både faglig og personlig – vi tilrettelegger for at du lykkes og når dine karrieremål
  • Lønn etter: Stillingskode: 751714
  • Ansettelser foretas fortløpende

Vi ber om at godkjente vitnemål/karakterutskrifter og attester lastes opp som vedlegg til den elektroniske søknaden. Dersom du ønsker å reservere deg fra oppføring på offentlig søkerliste, må dette begrunnes i søknadsskjema. Opplysningene kan bli offentliggjort selv om du har bedt om å ikke bli oppført på søkerlisten, men du vil bli varslet før søknadsfristens utløp, dersom ønsket om reservasjon ikke tas til følge.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Stavanger kommune er, med sine 11 000 ansatte, en av regionens største arbeidsgivere.

Vi mener inkludering og mangfold er en styrke. Vi er opptatt av at arbeidsstyrken i størst mulig grad skal gjenspeile mangfoldet i samfunnet, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte til å søke, uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. 

Vi jobber for heltidskultur med mål  om å ansette i hele stillinger.

Som ansatt i Stavanger kommune får du utgjøre en forskjell for kommunen og innbyggerne og blir en del av en spennende storbyregion. 

Vi bygger fellesskap ved å være nære, åpne og nyskapende

Offentlig søkerliste: 
Stavanger kommune praktiserer prinsippet om meroffentlighet. Offentlig søkerliste vil normalt inneholde navn på samtlige søkere. Det må foreligge tungtveiende grunner for å få innvilget unntak, jamfør Offentleglova §25.

Politiattest:
Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges før tiltredelse for stillinger der det er påkrevd iht. lovverk.

Vedlegg:
Attester, vitnemål og vedlegg må legges ved søknaden. Vi oppfordrer til å bruke Vitnemålsportalen. Utdanning utført utenfor Norge må være godkjent av Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse (eller NOKUT), og godkjenningen må dokumenteres.

title: Project Controller
employer: CHR MICHELSENS INSTITUTT FOR VIDENSKAP OG ÅNDSFRIHET STI
description:
Project Controller position available

The Chr. Michelsen Institute (CMI) has one, 100%, permanent Project Controller position available. CMI is a private research institute with English as the working language.

This position replaces a team member who is transitioning to a new role. 

The position is part of the Project Unit within the institute's Administration and reports to the Head of Projects. The Project Unit works across CMI to facilitate research and commissioned projects throughout their lifecycle by providing expert advice in grant management and project administration.

The preferred start date is January/February 2027. 


Job description and essential work tasks

As a Project Controller, you will work as part of the Project Unit at CMI with responsibility for a dedicated project portfolio, ensuring sustainable operations and continuous professional development of oneself and the unit.

The Project Unit is responsible for: 

  • The full lifecycle of research projects, including budgeting, financial monitoring, reporting, invoicing, contracts, and project close-out.
  • Compliance with funding regulations and legislation, contribute to the continuous development of grant management practices, and foster collaboration and knowledge sharing within the Project Unit and across the Institute.
  • Supporting application processes by providing administrative, financial, and compliance expertise.
  • Monitoring the market for commissioned research opportunities. 

Key work tasks in the Project Controller role

  • Provide financial and administrative oversight of research projects throughout their entire lifecycle, from the proposal stage to project completion.
  • Collaborate and communicate closely with researchers involved in the research projects within your assigned project portfolio.
  • Provide professional and administrative support for grant applications and tenders to national and international funding bodies and clients; contributing to the development of new project proposals.
  • Prepare project budgets, financial reports, invoices, and process financial documentation.
  • Manage the formal and legal aspects of agreements and contracts, including further developing and adapting contract templates.
  • Ensure the quality of administrative and financial reporting to funding agencies and clients.

What We Are Looking for in a Project Controller

Experience and Qualifications

  • A higher education degree in a relevant field.
  • Experience in project administration and financial control.
  • Understanding of grant compliance, funding regulations, and research administration.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Norwegian and English.
  • Experience with funding programmes from the Research Council of Norway and the European Union is an advantage.
  • Experience with commissioned work acquisition and bid management is an advantage. 

Personal skills

You are a proactive and solution-oriented professional who works effectively both independently and as part of diverse teams. 

You are organised, able to manage competing priorities and deadlines, communicate clearly and professionally, and are comfortable navigating digital systems and administrative processes. 

You enjoy learning, adapting to new requirements, and following through to deliver results.


CMI can offer you:
  • The opportunity to be part of a knowledge organization contributing to societal change. 
  • A vibrant and international working environment, with English as the primary working language.
  • Work-life balance and home office opportunities.
  • This position is placed either in the Adviser or Senior Adviser category, wage is determined by the position category and the candidate's experience. 
  • Salary for Adviser positions starts at NOK 688 271.-
  • Salary for Senior Adviser positions starts at NOK 787 831.- . 

Relevant staff benefits:

  • In addition to the annual 5 weeks holiday leave, CMI offers staff additional paid leave from the 24th of December to the 1st of January, and during the Easter week each year.
  • Support for gym membership.
  • Excellent travel insurance that covers both work and private travel (terms apply).
  • Defined contribution pension (innskuddspension). Contributions are paid with 7% of the salary up to 7.1 G and 25.1% of the salary between 7.1-12 G (2% are deducted from the employee, terms apply).

Location 

This position is located in Bergen, Norway. CMI is not in a position to offer remote working arrangements for new staff members. We offer home office agreements, allowing all staff to work up to two days a week from home office in Norway.


How to apply:

CMI only accepts applications through the JobbNorge recruitment system.

Please submit the following:

  • A cover page outlining your motivation for the position, and your qualification for the role
  • CV
  • Proof of highest degree received (i.e., copy of diploma or transcript)
  • A minimum of three references, including phone numbers and e-mail addresses

The application deadline is set to the: 15th of October 2026. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

CMI is an independent, development research institute based in Bergen, Norway, with around 110 staff members. In cooperation with partners from all over the world, we address key development challenges in Africa, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and Latin America.

We combine high-quality research with an engagement to make knowledge accessible and used. We work in multi-disciplinary teams, where the main disciplines are economics, political science, and social anthropology. We have an international staff and an engaging working environment.

Our vision is 'research for a just and equal world', and our mission is to address global challenges by providing research-based knowledge that inspires and shapes policy and practice.

Our values are: inclusive & empathetic, collaborative, curious & bold and respectful. You can read CMI's strategy, vision, mission and values in full here: Who we are (cmi.no). 

CMI's strategic priorities for 2023-2028 are:

  • High-quality research: increasingly be internationally recognized for cutting edge, interdisciplinary academic and policy-relevant research.
  • Impact for societal change: To strengthen our influence, and shape public debates and policies in our fields of expertise.
  • Equal knowledge production: To be a role model in equal and inclusive partnerships in all of our endeavors.

CMI's structural priorities for 2023-2028 are:

  • An inclusive workplace: CMI must have an inclusive and healthy work culture that encourages and thrives on diversity, including in perspectives.
  • A developing & sustainable organization: CMI continues to adapt to changing needs and requirements by having sufficient staff with the right competencies, resources, and technology to support our operations.
  • Social responsibility: CMI works for sustainability in all areas of our operations, especially those focused on environmental, social and governance issues.

title: Vil du gjøre en forskjell for barna – hver eneste dag? Vi søker barnehagelærer med stort engasjement!
description:
Bli med å få verdens viktigste verdier til å vokse
Har du hjerte for barn? Barnas hverdag og selvfølelse er prisgitt gode voksne som aktivt deltar og genuint er interessert i å lytte og forstå. Vi søker deg som har de samme tankene og som brenner for at barn skal ha en trygg og god barnehage å være i.  


Da en av våre ansatte skal ut i permisjon, søker vi nå etter 100% barnehagelærer  i et vikariat fra 4. januar 2027 t.om. 14. mai 2027.


Hvorfor jobbe hos oss?
Hos oss jobber du med engasjerte og dyktige kollegaer i et stort fagmiljø! Vi har et attraktivt pedagogisk konsept med tilgang til mye pedagogisk materiell i vår ressursbank. Du holder deg faglig oppdatert ved å delta på kurs og fagopplæring som tilbys, bl.a. gjennom Læringsverkstedet Akademiet. Vi har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, samt tariffavtale gjennom PBL. Læringsverkstedet har et løfte til alle ansatte: "Hos oss har du alle muligheter til å utvikle deg både faglig og menneskelig, og gjøre verdens viktigste jobb på best mulig måte."Er du den vi leter etter?
Som barnehagelærer er du faglig og administrativ medansvarlig, som aktivt implementerer Læringsverkstedets verdiplattform og kvalitetsstandarder. Du bidrar i utførelse og planlegging av daglige gjøremål, prosjekter og aktiviteter, på lang og kort sikt.
Hvordan en arbeidshverdag ser ut
  • Påse at barnehagen drives i samsvar med Læringsverkstedets verdiplattform
  • Skape et trygt, godt, engasjerende og spennende læringsmiljø for barn og ansatte
  • Dele kunnskap om barns læring og utvikling, og bidra til kompetanseheving i barnehagen
  • Veilede og støtte det øvrige personalet i det pedagogiske/metodiske arbeidet
  • Være en pådriver i evalueringsarbeid og kontinuerlig forbedring
  • Ha medansvar for tilretteleggingen for et godt samarbeid med foresatte
  • I pedagogisk leder sitt fravær skal barnehagelæreren være stedfortreder

 
Hvem vi tror kan passe i rollen
Du er være en relasjonsorientert person som ser hvert enkelt barn. Du lytter og er lydhør på hva barna ønsker å formidle. Du har faglige ambisjoner og et hjerte for det du driver med. Videre har du evnen til å skape engasjement og lyst til å delta i barns lek og utvikling.

Du fremstår som løsningsorientert, fleksibel og samarbeidsvillig. For å lykkes i rollen må du kunne kommunisere med mennesker med ulik bakgrunn og i ulike livssituasjoner. Du liker nye utfordringer og jobber godt under press, videre er du ansvarsbevisst og selvstendig. Vi ønsker en barnehagelærer som er god, varm og en omsorgsfull voksenperson. Leken og ambisiøs, raus og tydelig er stikkord for vårt personale. Du må identifisere deg med Læringsverkstedets verdier
 
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Godkjent høyskoleutdannelse som barnehagelærer eller førskolelærer
  • Erfaring fra barnehage er ønskelig, men ikke et krav
  • Du er en aktiv voksen som ser hvert enkelt barn, som lytter og bryr seg om hva barna ønsker å formidle
  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både skriftlig og muntlig
  • Politiattest må fremlegges før ansettelse, men skal ikke legges ved søknaden
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt
Om Læringsverkstedet
I Læringsverkstedet jobber vi for å få barna til å vokse – i kunnskap og mestring, i trygghet og empati. Vi ser etter medarbeidere som ønsker å bidra og gi av seg selv, som evner å lytte til andre, dele erfaringer og styrke felles ambisjoner. Viljen til hele tiden å bli bedre, både faglig og menneskelig, er en forutsetning for alle som jobber i Læringsverkstedet.Vi er en av Norges største private barnehageeiere med 250 barnehager og 7000 ansatte som eies og driftes av pedagoger. Who we are looking for

As our Founding Business Development Representative (BDR), you'll be the engine behind our sales pipeline - the first Birdsview person many prospects talk to. You'll open doors across Europe and beyond, working closely with our sales team to turn interest into qualified opportunities.

Birdsview - Prolonging the lifetime of the built world

Birdsview is a Norwegian technology company on a mission to change the way we preserve critical infrastructure to ensure a more sustainable and secure future.

Infrastructure is one of society’s most important assets. It includes the buildings we live in, the bridges we cross and the power grid that provides us with electricity. These structures are aging rapidly, and solutions that help preserve and secure critical infrastructure are now needed more than ever.

Birdsview's state-of-the-art technology combines radar (GPR), lidar, and AI to visualize what’s inside structures without destructive interventions. This allows for efficient and cost-effective inspection and monitoring of our most precious infrastructures - and enables clear, user-friendly visualizations that enhance understanding, extend asset lifespan, and promote material reuse - ultimately reducing costs and CO₂ emissions.

We are 17 people, we have customers in 9 countries, and we raised NOK 40.5 million from leading Nordic VC's to scale internationally.

About the job and why it matters

Much of concrete inspection today still relies on manual methods and fragmented, ageing non-destructive testing (NDT) equipment. You will help structural engineers, contractors, surveying specialists, and asset owners see clearly what is hidden inside the concrete. New critical data, faster inspections, and real cost savings are why they want our technology in their daily projects.

As a Founding BDA, you will be the engine behind our international growth. The role is to reach the right prospects, understand the problems they face, and show them what our technology does. You will build target account lists in HubSpot, make cold calls, drive LinkedIn and email outreach, and book qualified meetings for our sales team.
