title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
Mechanical Design Engineer – Advanced Vehicle Concept Development

Employer: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB

Location: Södertälje, Stockholm County, Sweden

Employment Type: Full-time (100%)

Assignment Period: 12 October 2026 – 31 October 2028

Working Language: English (Swedish is considered an advantage but is not required.)

About the Role

Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer to join an assignment with one of Sweden's leading automotive engineering teams in Södertälje.

The assignment focuses on advanced engineering and concept vehicle development, where new technologies within electrification, hydrogen, and e-Mining are explored and developed for future vehicle platforms.

You will work in a fast-paced research and development environment, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams across R&D, Production, and other engineering stakeholders. The role requires a flexible and solution-oriented engineer who enjoys working with concept development and evolving technical requirements.

Key Responsibilities

    Contribute to concept development and early-phase mechanical design for advanced vehicle platforms.
    Create and maintain 3D models and concept-level drawings using CATIA V5.
    Develop technical solutions for cooling systems, braking systems, steering systems, and battery installations.
    Support vehicle layout and packaging activities to ensure design feasibility.
    Collaborate with R&D, Production, Manufacturing Engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders throughout the development process.
    Perform or support FEM calculations and design validation activities.
    Participate in technical reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of engineering solutions.
    Deliver concept-level design solutions within project timelines while maintaining engineering quality.

Required Qualifications

    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
    Minimum 7 years of professional experience in mechanical design or a related engineering field.
    Strong experience in concept development and early-stage product development within the automotive or heavy vehicle industry.
    Proven hands-on experience with CATIA V5 (3D) for mechanical design and assemblies.
    Good knowledge of ENOVIA or a similar Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system.
    Experience in designing and integrating Battery Electric Vehicle (BEV) solutions.
    Good understanding of vehicle layout, packaging, and system integration.
    Experience with cooling systems, braking systems, steering systems, or battery components is highly meritorious.
    Knowledge of Finite Element Method (FEM) for design validation is an advantage.
    Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced engineering environment with changing project requirements.
    Strong communication and collaboration skills with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
    Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Who You Are

You are a flexible and solution-oriented engineer with a strong technical foundation in mechanical design. You are comfortable working in an environment with a high level of uncertainty and enjoy contributing to innovative concept development. You take ownership of your work, collaborate effectively across functions, and deliver high-quality engineering solutions within demanding timelines.

title: Sjuksköterska söks till ett uppdrag i slutenvård
description:
Sjuksköterska för regional verksamhet

Din kompetens gör skillnad. Vi ser människan bakom.

Som sjuksköterska vet du att en bra arbetsdag handlar om mer än själva uppdraget. Det handlar om att känna sig trygg, uppskattad och ha en samarbetspartner som finns där när du behöver det.

På VårdIX vill vi skapa just den känslan.

Vi samarbetar med sjuksköterskor inom slutenvårdsavdelningar, mottagningar och primärvård och vill hitta uppdrag som passar både din kompetens och det liv du vill leva.

För oss är det viktigt att du känner dig trygg från första kontakten och genom hela ditt uppdrag. Därför finns vi nära, är tillgängliga och håller det vi lovar.

Tydliga villkor från början

Vi tror på att vara raka och tydliga. Du ska veta vad uppdraget innebär, vilka villkor som gäller och vad du kan förvänta dig av oss.

Inga konstigheter och inga överraskningar – bara en öppen dialog där vi tillsammans hittar det som passar dig.

Din kompetens ska synas i dina villkor

Din kompetens och erfarenhet är värdefull och ska också synas i dina villkor. Vi arbetar för att skapa uppdrag som ger dig en attraktiv ersättning och samtidigt en långsiktig och hållbar konsultvardag.

Vi vill lära känna dig som person

Vad får dig att trivas? Vilken typ av arbetsplats passar dig? Vad är viktigt för att du ska känna arbetsglädje?

För oss är du inte bara en sjuksköterska som fyller ett uppdrag – du är en person vi vill bygga en långsiktig relation med.

VårdIX handlar om trygghet, tydlighet och bra villkor – men också om gemenskap.

Känner du igen dig? Då vill vi gärna lära känna dig.

Uppdraget gäller från 2 nov 2026 till 3 jan 2027

title: Sjuksköterska söks till ett uppdrag i Uppsala kommun
description:
Sjuksköterska – kommunal verksamhet

Ett tryggt uppdrag börjar med ett tryggt samarbete.

Att arbeta som sjuksköterska inom kommunal verksamhet innebär ett stort ansvar. På SÄBO, inom hemsjukvård och LSS är din kompetens viktig varje dag – och ofta är du en central person för både patienter, närstående och kollegor.

På VårdIX vill vi att du ska känna samma trygghet i ditt samarbete med oss som du skapar för andra i ditt arbete.

Personlig kontakt och stöd genom hela uppdraget

Vi vill finnas nära dig genom hela uppdraget och vara en partner du kan lita på. Därför lägger vi stor vikt vid personlig kontakt och tillgänglighet.

Du ska veta vem du kan vända dig till och känna att vi lyssnar när du har frågor eller behöver stöd.

Tydliga villkor från början

Vi tror på tydlighet från början. När du får ett uppdrag hos oss ska du känna att du har koll på förutsättningarna, villkoren och vad som förväntas av dig.

Vi tror att transparens skapar förtroende – och att ett bra samarbete bygger på att man är rak med varandra.

Lönsamt att vara konsult

Din erfarenhet, kompetens och flexibilitet har ett värde. Därför arbetar vi för att erbjuda villkor som känns attraktiva och rättvisa.

Mer än bara ett uppdrag

VårdIX är mer än ett uppdrag. Vi vill att du ska känna att du tillhör något även när du arbetar ute hos en av våra kunder.

Därför vill vi lära känna dig, förstå vad som är viktigt för dig och bygga en relation som sträcker sig längre än nästa arbetspass.

Du bidrar med din kompetens. Vi bidrar med tryggheten runt omkring.

Kanske är det dags att upptäcka vad ett samarbete med VårdIX kan innebära för dig?

title: VP of Customer Success
description:
This is not a typical Customer Success role. You'll own net revenue retention across renewals, expansion, training, and customer marketing for a global customer base, with a direct line into shaping the product itself.

We're a 125-person EdTech scale-up powering learning in 140+ countries, helping students and teachers thrive through an intelligent platform that combines rich, interactive pedagogy with smart AI and data.

Why join Kognity?

    Work on problems that matter – Your work directly influences the lives of teachers and students in over 140 countries. The scale is global, and the outcomes are tangible.
    High ownership, high expectations – You are trusted to take initiative, make decisions and drive outcomes. Responsibility comes early, accountability is real, and results matter.
    A fast-moving, high-performing team – You will work with smart, driven colleagues across the globe on complex problems. Standards and expectations are high, feedback is direct, and the pace is fast.
    Continuous growth is the baseline – Everyone is expected and supported to learn quickly, improve constantly and raise their own bar. If you enjoy responsibility, momentum and meaningful challenge, you will thrive here.

What you'll do:

    Own and achieve the NRR target for Customer Success across all markets, covering renewals and expansion
    Build a structure across Account Management, Training, Professional Development and Customer Marketing with clear roles and no major gaps or overlaps
    Own, develop and implement the CS strategy and post-sales processes across markets, with full decision-making authority over prioritisation, team structure and resource allocation
    Set a clear approach for how CS uses communication and training to drive adoption and retention.
    Advise the leadership team on Customer Success strategy and forecasts alongside the CRO, and lead cross-team collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Product, Content and Enablement

What we're looking for:

    Proven track record of growing net revenue retention through renewals and upsell strategies in a SaaS business
    Strategic thinking beyond Account Management, with clear prioritisation in a complex environment and strong judgement in ambiguity
    Ability to lead and inspire with confidence for maximum revenue outcomes, and to build capability in others
    Ability to effectively identify problems with impact on NRR within and outside the CS team, and develop and implement appropriate solution sets
    Executive-level communication and cross-functional influence, with the ability to work closely with senior stakeholders across the business

How we hire

    Discovery call with a Recruiter
    Hiring manager discussion
    Case study
    Values discussion
    Leadership talk
    References

Every qualified person will be evaluated regardless of age, gender, identity, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status or religion. We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive team and welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

title: Office Manager
description:
About us

Hacksaw Studios is a Stockholm-based game studio focused on creating innovative, high-quality gaming experiences. With a focus on performance and precision, we bring ideas to life through technical expertise and creative collaboration. We have wide distribution, and our games are played by millions of people every month by players all over the world.

We are now looking for a proactive and service-minded Office Manager who enjoys creating structure, solving problems, and making sure the office is a great place to be.

You are someone who notices the small things before anyone has to ask. Whether it’s preparing for an upcoming event, making sure the office is fully stocked, welcoming a delivery, or finding a quick solution to an unexpected problem, you approach each task with energy and a positive attitude.

The Role

As our Office Manager, you will play an important part in the everyday experience at our Stockholm office. You will help ensure that the workplace remains organized, welcoming, and ready for whatever the day brings.

This is a hands-on role with plenty of variety. It offers the opportunity to gain practical experience in office coordination, administration, and event planning while working in a creative and fast-moving environment.

Your key responsibilities include:

    Making sure shared office areas are tidy, welcoming, and well-stocked
    Coordinating purchases and orders for office supplies, snacks, and other essentials
    Receiving deliveries and handling practical office-related requests
    Supporting the planning and coordination of internal events and activities
    Assisting with day-to-day office administration
    Identifying practical improvements and helping put them into action
    Handling unexpected situations calmly and finding effective solutions
    Contributing to a positive office experience for employees and visitors

What We’re Looking For

You enjoy helping others and take pride in creating an organized and welcoming workplace. You are reliable, attentive, and comfortable managing both planned tasks and unexpected situations.

You bring:

    A proactive, practical, and solution-oriented approach
    Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
    Previous experience in administration, office coordination, hospitality, or another service-oriented role
    The ability to manage several tasks and shift priorities when needed
    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
    A positive attitude and a strong sense of responsibility
    Fluency in English and Swedish
    Availability to work from our Stockholm office

Nice-to-have:

    Experience supporting internal events or workplace activities
    An interest in games, technology, or the creative industries

Practical Details

    Employment type: Full-time, permanent employment starting with a probationary period
    Location: On-site at our Stockholm office
    Start date: As soon as possible

Ready to Join the Game Makers?

Think you can keep things running smoothly while adding good vibes along the way? Apply now! We review applications on a rolling basis.

If you have any questions about the role or the application process, don’t hesitate to reach out.

Join Hacksaw Studios and help keep the creativity flowing!

title: Game Designer
description:
About us

Hacksaw Studios is a Stockholm-based game studio focused on creating innovative, high-quality gaming experiences. With a focus on performance and precision, we bring ideas to life through technical expertise and creative collaboration. We have wide distribution, and our games are played by millions of people every month by players all over the world.

We are currently seeking a Game Designer to join our Product & Innovation team, someone who thrives on generating bold, original ideas and turning them into compelling game concepts.

The Role

As a Game Designer at Hacksaw Studios, you'll be at the forefront of shaping our future game portfolio. This is a highly creative, research-driven role where you'll spend the majority of your time conceptualising, designing, and refining game ideas across a wide range of themes, mechanics, and visual styles.

Your key responsibilities include:

    Generate a continuous pipeline of original game concepts across multiple genres, themes, and mechanics.
    Contribute to and help shape the visual identity, art direction, and presentation style across game concepts.
    Develop innovative gameplay features, bonus systems, progression mechanics, and player engagement concepts.
    Create and explore new visual directions, themes, artistic concepts, and presentation styles.
    Monitor industry trends, emerging mechanics, player preferences, and competitor releases.
    Research adjacent industries, entertainment trends, and popular culture as sources of inspiration.
    Produce clear and structured concept proposals for evaluation and further development.

What We're Looking For

You bring:

    Experience within game design, product development, creative development, or a related discipline within the gaming industry.
    A strong understanding of game mechanics, player psychology, and engagement principles.
    A demonstrated ability to generate original ideas and translate them into structured concepts.
    Strong awareness of gaming trends and market developments.
    Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Nice-to-have:

    Experience with slot game design or casino gaming.
    Background in art direction, visual design leadership, or creative direction.
    A personal interest in games and a genuine curiosity about what makes products successful.
    Comfort with exploring unconventional ideas and challenging established thinking.

What We Offer

    A modern office in central Stockholm.
    Work with experienced, passionate colleagues in the gaming industry.
    The opportunity to shape games with a global audience.
    Real influence, ownership, and personal growth opportunities.
    Wellbeing perks including wellness allowance.

Practical Details

    This is an on-site position in Stockholm.
    Unfortunately, we cannot assist with relocation or visa sponsorship.

Ready to Join the Game Makers?

Apply now! We review applications on a rolling basis.

title: Core Value Leader Health & Safety
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

At Volvo Construction Equipment, safety is more than a priority – it is a core value that guides everything we do.

As Core Value Leader Safety, you will play a key role in driving a proactive safety culture across Sales Regions Europe and International, supporting both our own operations and our retail network. Through leadership, expertise and collaboration, you will help ensure strong safety performance and continuous improvement across multiple markets.



In this role, you will act as the subject matter expert for Occupational Health & Safety within the Sales organisation, working closely with the Volvo CE Head of Safety, regional sales teams and retail partners. Together, you will strengthen a people-centric and proactive approach to safety across our international distribution network.

The position offers flexibility in location. The role can be based at one of our owned retail operations in Norway, Denmark, Finland, Poland, Sweden or Germany, or at another Volvo CE office in Europe.



Your responsibilities

As Core Value Leader Safety, you will drive the development and implementation of safety frameworks, standards and initiatives across the sales organisation and retail network.



Your responsibilities include:

    Leading the development and implementation of Occupational Health & Safety policies, standards and roadmaps
    Acting as the Safety champion for the Sales organisation, supporting regions and retail partners with methodologies, tools and best practices
    Strengthening a proactive safety culture through awareness, engagement and training activities
    Planning and coordinating safety audits and assessments across Volvo CE and the retail network together with regional safety champions
    Conducting and supporting safety assessments to identify workplace hazards and unsafe practices
    Establishing tracking, reporting and follow-up structures to monitor safety performance and support senior leadership
    Analysing regulatory changes and working conditions to ensure continued compliance with relevant safety standards
    Supporting accident investigations and root cause analysis to identify preventive actions and share learnings across the organisation

Who you are

You are a passionate safety professional who believes that strong safety performance is built through leadership, engagement and continuous improvement.

You combine solid safety expertise with strong communication and collaboration skills, enabling you to influence stakeholders across an international organisation and retail network.



You likely bring:

    Extensive experience working with Occupational Health & Safety
    Good knowledge of ISO 45001 and other relevant international safety standards
    Experience from safety audits, assessments and incident investigations
    A structured and analytical approach with a strong focus on continuous improvement
    The ability to coach, engage and influence stakeholders at different levels of the organisation
    Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in an international environment
    Fluency in English, written and spoken. Additional languages are considered an advantage.



Qualifications

    Degree in a technical, engineering or business-related field
    Trained or certified auditor / assessor
    Experience of project or change management in an international environment
    Nationally or internationally recognised health and safety qualification
    Willingness to travel regularly within Volvo CE’s international retail network



Why Volvo CE

At Volvo Construction Equipment, our core values Safety, Quality and Environmental Care guide everything we do. In this role, you will have the opportunity to strengthen safety culture across an international retail network and contribute to safer workplaces every day.

You will join a collaborative global organisation where people, safety and continuous improvement are at the heart of how we work.

Ready for the next move?

We look forward to receiving your application. The last day to apply is 15 October.

For more information about the position, please contact the hiring manager, David Herwarth von Bittenfeld, david.herwarth.von.bittenfeld@volvo.com

Join us in shaping a safer and more sustainable future.

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.



Who we are and what we believe in

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.



Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.



Part of Volvo Group, Volvo Construction Equipment is a global company driven by our purpose to build the world we want to live in. Together we develop and deliver solutions for a cleaner, smarter, and more connected world. By unleashing everyone’s full potential, we build a more sustainable future for all our stakeholders. Come join our team and help us build a better tomorrow.

title: R&D Manager
description:
Wibe Group is an international industrial organization with approximately 400 employees and operations across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Netherlands, UK, India and Malaysia. We develops smart, cost-effective industrial product solutions with a focus on modularity, quality, sustainability and ease of installation.

Wibe group is looking for

R&D MANAGER

The company is now strengthening its R&D function in Mora and is looking for a senior leader who can create structure, build common ways of working and turn strategy into execution.

Why join Wibe Group?

This is an opportunity to lead an experienced, international engineering team and shape how product development is managed across the organization. You will combine leadership with hands-on project responsibility, establish clear priorities and ensure that R&D efforts support the product strategy and category roadmaps.

The role offers a broad mandate and close collaboration with Category Management, Brand, PDM, Operations, Sales and PMO. You will have the opportunity to simplify processes, improve delivery performance and create lasting structure in a function with strong technical competence.

What we offer

    Lead, coach and develop a team of four engineers focused primarily on mechanical design and engineering in Mora
    Develop, align and execute a 3-5-year technical roadmap in line with the product strategy
    Drive innovation, standardization, modularization, continuous improvement and cost optimization across our product portfolio
    Lead your own development projects while supporting and directing the work of the engineering team
    Create clear processes, priorities and common ways of working within the R&D function
    Influence budget planning, competence development, resource allocation and future recruitment
    Work in a cross-functional and international industrial environment, collaborating closely with production, sourcing and other key stakeholders



About the role

As R&D Manager, you are responsible for turning identified market and product opportunities into relevant, robust and cost-effective technical solutions. You will lead the R&D team, set direction and ensure that projects are delivered on time, within budget and in line with required functionality, quality, sustainability and compliance standards.

A key part of the assignment is to create structure and discipline in the development process. You will clarify project scope, establish common ways of working, simplify processes and help the team focus on doing the right things. The role is both strategic and operational and includes responsibility for selected development projects.

Your main responsibilities include:

    Owning the technical roadmap, platform strategy and product roadmap
    Leading product and system development, including key modules and interfaces
    Ensuring documentation, validation, testing and certification compliance
    Managing the R&D budget, external consultants and resource allocation
    Recruiting, coaching and developing engineers and supporting succession planning
    Improving time-to-market, cost efficiency, processes and tools
    Collaborating with internal stakeholders and certification bodies
    Identifying and escalating technical, safety and strategic risks

The role is based in Mora and reports within Product & Marketing. Limited travel may occur.



What we are looking for

We are looking for a senior and pragmatic leader with solid experience in product development in an industrial or heavy engineering environment. You understand how structured processes create business value and have the authority and judgement to set priorities, make decisions and address difficult issues when needed.

We believe you have:

    A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, Product Design or a related field
    Extensive experience in industrial product development, preferably in environments close to manufacturing
    Proven leadership experience and the ability to assess, coach and develop technical competence
    Experience of working with clearly defined project scopes and market requirements
    Knowledge of NPI/NPD, mechanical product design and DfX principles
    Experience of risk management, validation planning, FMEA, cost engineering or value engineering
    Experience of PLM and engineering systems; Windchill and CREO are relevant examples
    An understanding of Six Sigma, Lean or other structured continuous-improvement methods
    Experience of international or matrix organizations
    Good English communication skills

Experience of offshore applications, high-specification industrial standards, IEC or ISO requirements is an advantage.

As a person, you are structured, present and decisive. You build trust across cultures, create clarity and psychological safety, and are comfortable holding difficult conversations. You combine a strategic perspective with a strong ability to implement, follow through and deliver measurable improvements.



Employment

This is a full-time permanent position based in Mora. The role requires a high level of on-site presence. Starting date is agreed with the successful candidate.



How we recruit

Wibe Group is partnering with Hansson & Partners in this recruitment. Please submit your application via Hansson & Partners no later than 18 October.

The selection process is based on your previous experience and personal capabilities, including personality profiling and logical reasoning. We use a competency-based approach to support an objective and non-discriminatory recruitment process. The process may include work-psychology assessments, in-depth interviews and a background check of the final candidate.

In accordance with GDPR, please do not include sensitive personal data in your application.



About Hansson & Partners

Hansson & Partners is a consulting company with deep roots in Dalarna, specialising in recruitment for qualified positions, strategic HR and interim assignments. With extensive industry experience, the company helps organisations find the right leaders and key talent through a competency-based and objective process. Quality, integrity and personal commitment are central to every assignment.

title: VP Domain Head, AI Scaling Hub - Operational Excellence
description:
TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let´s make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com



Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do.

We are looking for a new colleague within VP Domain Head, AI Scaling Hub - Operational Excellence who wants to join the Group R&D change journey.

The role offers the flexibility to be based in any of the locations where the Group HR R&D organization operates (Nürnberg, Germany; Södertälje, Sweden; Lisle, USA or Resende, Brasil), depending on the candidate’s preference and location.

Applications submitted through this platform will not be processed. Role Summary

TRATON Group R&D is going through a major transformation to become an even stronger global R&D organization, capable of delivering on a time-critical Group R&D roadmap while driving competitiveness and customer value across the TRATON brands.

As VP Domain Head, AI Scaling Hub - Operational Excellence, you will lead the operational excellence agenda for the AI Scaling Hub, working across Group R&D, the brands, and central functions. Your mission is to help turn AI ambition into practical, scalable, and value-creating ways of working. This role requires someone who can create clarity, build trust, connect strategy with execution, and drive transformation in a complex international environment.

Internal applicants from TRATON Group R&D are prioritized for this position. Candidates from the broader TRATON Group (including brands) are welcome to apply and may be reviewed based on business needs.

Job Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

•    Lead and further develop the operating model for the AI Scaling Hub, ensuring clear priorities, governance, and performance follow-up.

•    Drive cross-functional collaboration across Group R&D, brands, and central functions to align priorities, remove obstacles, and accelerate progress.

•    Identify opportunities where AI can create measurable business value and support the transformation of ways of working across the organization.

•    Establish pragmatic governance structures, portfolio steering mechanisms, and value-tracking frameworks that enable execution without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

•    Support and guide strategic initiatives related to AI adoption, operational excellence, and organizational effectiveness.

•    Foster a culture characterized by curiosity, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

•    Act as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders, balancing Group-wide objectives with local business realities and needs.

As our AI Scaling Hub is part of TRATON Group R&D, we are closely collaborating with all brands in the Group. In your role it’s therefore important to have a Group perspective while taking all brands into consideration.

Who You Are

We believe you bring many of the following:

•    Extensive experience in operational excellence, transformation management, business operations, strategy execution, program leadership, or related areas within a complex international environment.

•    Proven success in leading cross-functional transformation initiatives and creating clarity in organizations with multiple stakeholders and dependencies.

•    Strong understanding of AI, data, analytics, and digital transformation, enabling you to effectively bridge business and technical perspectives.

•    Experience designing or improving operating models, governance frameworks, portfolio management processes, and performance management structures.

•    Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead through influence and collaboration.

•    Strong strategic thinking combined with a pragmatic, execution-oriented mindset.

Experience from R&D, advanced engineering, analytics, technology, or other innovation-driven environments will be considered an advantage.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives are valuable to us.

This Is Us

Within Operational Excellence, we combine ambition with humility. We believe meaningful progress happens when capable people listen well, work together, and turn complexity into something others can act on. That is the spirit we hope this role will bring.

Within TRATON Group R&D, you are an important part of something bigger. Joining us means gaining access to the ins and outs of the entire transportation industry. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Being bigger also means being stronger. Together with our brands, we have the collective power to transform transportation.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 20.10.2026. Don't apply directly here, follow this link International Motor- Careers - VP Domain Head, AI Scaling Hub - Operational Excellence, TRATON R&D US, LLC in Lisle, Illinois | Careers at International WHQ (Lisle) to apply. title: Licensing Operations Specialist
description:
At the Electrolux Group, a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.

Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute and grow together.

Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home!

About the role:

You will manage and support global licensing operations to ensure licensed products, partners, and processes comply with contractual, brand, and operational requirements.

You will manage licensing systems, data integrity, reporting, and cross‑functional coordination, playing a critical role in enabling compliance, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement across licensing business areas.

Location

The role is based in Stockholm (Sweden).  

What you’ll do:

    Maintain accurate and up‑to‑date licensing contract records in internal systems.
    Support the administration of licensing agreements, including tracking key terms, timelines, and deliverables
    Prepare brand licensing overviews, summaries, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders
    Manage and update internal licensing, compliance, and monitoring systems (ex. Brand Comply, China Customs Database, etc.).
    Support the Quality department in the development, maintenance, and optimization of CStaR database.
    Conduct periodic audits of systems and records to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and compliance
    Collaborate with Quality to produce and deliver quarterly CSTAR monitoring reports for licensees across all Business Areas (BAs)
    Provide quarterly updates of licensee customer service contacts and product reference lists, coordinating with Account Managers for accuracy and with Electrolux’s Customer Service teams for execution and visibility
    Train internal team members and external partners (including licensees) on licensing systems, tools, and processes
    Partner closely with Legal, Quality, Finance, Design and other internal teams to ensure aligned inputs, documentation accuracy, and compliance
    Assist in preparing authorization letters, trademark registrations, and related licensing documentation
    Maintain and govern the Global Licensing Procedure Manual, including review and implementation of new procedures and updates to existing documentation
    Support sustainability‑related licensing reporting, documentation, and data requests
    Identify operational inefficiencies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across licensing processes

Who you are:

    Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
    3–5 years of experience in licensing operations, brand operations, quality operations, supply chain or related roles
    Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office tools
    Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills

title: Security Engineer II
description:
Sinch is pioneering the way the world communicates. More than 200,000 businesses — including Google, Uber, Paypal, Visa, Tinder, and many others — rely on Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email.

Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.

At Sinch we “Dream Big”, “Win Together”, “Keep it simple”, and “Make it Happen”. These values are our foundation!

DESCRIPTION

As a Security Engineer at Sinch, you will help safeguard our cloud and on-premise environments as an integral member of our global security team. Your focus will be on identifying potential risks, conducting vulnerability assessments, and supporting the security of our infrastructure. You will handle routine security evaluations independently while collaborating with and learning from senior engineers on more complex projects.

    Conduct vulnerability assessments and security testing across our products and systems.
    Proactively monitor and manage the attack surface across assigned environments, recommending and implementing mitigation strategies.
    Contribute to the implementation and maintenance of robust cloud hardening standards to continuously improve our security posture.
    Evaluate, deploy, and manage security tools, providing recommendations for improvements.
    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate security measures into DevOps processes and contribute to secure design best practices.
    Design and implement automation for security processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
    Participate in architectural reviews to ensure security is deeply embedded in all new infrastructure initiatives.
    Analyze emerging security threats and sharing insights and mitigation proposals with senior engineers.

This is a hybrid role based in Sweden, with Kalmar as the preferred location and Stockholm being an option.

REQUIREMENTS

    Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
    Hands-on industry experience in security engineering or a similar role.
    Proficiency in security tools and technologies.
    Pragmatic and analytical to problem-solving, clear communication, and good organizational skills.
    Preferred Certifications: CISSP, CCSP, AWS Certified Security - Specialty.

Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English.

Must currently reside in and be eligible for employment in Sweden. Relocation and visa sponsorship are not available for this role.

OUR HIRING PROCESS

We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.

We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/. No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!

title: Förändringsledare KAA
description:
Vill du vara med och göra Gävle ännu bättre med oss? I Gävle kommun arbetar vi engagerat tillsammans för att kunna erbjuda våra invånare en trygg och inspirerande miljö. Vi erbjuder dig en tillitsfull arbetsplats där du kan utvecklas i ditt arbete och växa som människa. Välkommen med din ansökan!

Inom Välfärd Gävle finns vår arbetsplats på Jägargatan 2. Här arbetar ca 120 medarbetare och sex enhetschefer. Vi arbetar i team och vi sitter i kontorslandskap och har tillgång till flera mötesrum och konferensrum. I byggnaden finns ett café och en reception. Allt arbete sker på plats och hit kommer även våra kunder. Hit går det bra med bussförbindelser och det finns många fina cykelvägar.

Vill du arbeta med ett coachande förhållningssätt och brinner för att se människor växa? Vill du bidra till att individer når utveckling, stabilitet, självständighet och egen försörjning? Perfekt då kan det vara just dig vi söker!

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Några av dina arbetsuppgifter

Huvuduppdraget för förändringsledare med inriktning mot Kommunens aktivitetsansvar (KAA) utgår från skollagen och innefattar registrering, uppsökande och genomförande av insatser till ungdomar som inte går i gymnasiet. Målet är att ungdomen ska hitta sin väg i första hand till studier, i andra hand till ett arbete. Insatserna i KAA är frivilliga och du behöver ha mycket god förmåga att skapa relation, stödja och motivera ungdomen. Tillsammans med individen arbetar du för att skapa vägar mot arbetsmarknaden.

Din roll

Genom aktiva insatser samt motivations- och förändringsarbete skapar du förutsättningar för ungdomen att ta nästa steg i sin utvecklingsresa. Arbetet består av motivationshöjande och vägledande insatser både enskilt och i grupp. Samverkan med kollegor och andra relevanta aktörer är av stor vikt för att lyckas med uppdraget. Du är ansvarig för ett antal ungdomar och ditt uppdrag är att driva processen tillsammans med individen för att nå målet att påbörja och lyckas med studier. Du kommer att arbeta nära dina kollegor i ett högpresterande och tight team i din enhet.

I rollen som förändringsledare kan även ingå att vara förändringsledare till personer som söker försörjningsstöd och av olika orsaker inte kan försörja sig själv. Arbetet består av motivationshöjande och vägledande insatser både enskilt och i grupp. Samverkan med kollegor och andra relevanta aktörer är av stor vikt för att lyckas med uppdraget.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som har akademisk examen såsom socionom, beteendevetare -pedagogisk inriktning, eller annan akademisk examen som arbetsgivaren bedömer relevant för tjänsten. Du har erfarenhet av liknande arbete under minst 1 år. Du har förmågan att skapa goda relationer, inspirera och motivera samt har goda kunskaper om olika vägar till utbildning.

Vi ser det som meriterande om du har:

    • Erfarenhet av att vägleda personer till studier
    • B-körkort och körvana av bil

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du:

    • Har förmåga att leda och motivera andra samt att sätta upp mål och riktning för verksamheten
    • Har förmåga att delegera arbetsuppgifter samt ge råd, stöd och möjlighet för dina medarbetares utveckling
    • Utstrålar trovärdighet och självförtroende
    • Talar tydligt och har förmågan att hålla presentationer, föreläsningar och utbildningar samt att anpassa dem efter målgruppens behov
    • Ser vad som behöver prioriteras, är effektiv och använder resurserna för att på bästa sätt nå resultat
    • Tar initiativ i sociala sammanhang och har en förmåga att skapa tillit i dina yrkesrelationer
    • Leder, motiverar och inspirerar andra, du får dem att utvecklas och må bra
    • Kan skapa en öppen dialog och anpassar ditt agerande utifrån aktuell situation
    • Skapar tillitsfulla relationer och får andra att känna sig trygg
    • Kommunicerar tydligt och förklarar bakgrunden till beslut
    • Ger, söker och tar konstruktiv feedback

För dig är det en självklarhet att utveckla verksamheten utifrån kundens behov och uppsatta mål. Du säkerställer och upprätthåller kvalitet och produktivitet. Du är skicklig på att identifierar samverkansmöjligheter för kundens bästa samt visa ekonomisk medvetenhet i förhållande till det egna arbetet och till hela kommunkoncernen.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: 2026-10-01  Eller enligt överenskommelse så snart som möjligt.

Vi erbjuder dig

Du är viktig för oss! Som medarbetare i Gävle kommun har du

    • generösa semestervillkor och som nyanställd har du dessutom rätt till betald semester redan under ditt första anställningsår
    • ersättning för friskvård och motion när du är anställd mer än tre månader
    • flera olika försäkringar via våra kollektivavtal, till exempel ingår sjukförsäkring och arbetsskadeförsäkring.

Läs mer om våra förmåner här: https://www.gavle.se/formaner

Vår värdegrund

Kvalitet, bemötande och samarbete är de viktigaste framgångsfaktorerna för att lösa vårt uppdrag på bästa sätt. För att göra rätt saker och agera klokt i vår vardag är det viktigt att vi utgår från våra gemensamt uttalade värderingar.

Läs mer om oss som arbetsgivare och hur det är att arbeta i Gävle kommun här:

https://www.gavle.se/jobbahososs

Här kan du läsa mer om vår organisation:

https://www.gavle.se/organisation

Gävle kommun hör till finskt förvaltningsområde. Om du därför utöver våra övriga kompetenskrav även talar finska, kan det vara en merit.

Information till rekryteringskonsulter och annonssäljare: Vi undanber oss all kontakt gällande annonsering och rekryteringstjänster.

title: RF & Digital Design Engineers  mmWave & Beamforming
description:
RF & Digital Design Engineers – mmWave & Beamforming

📍 Location: Lund, Sweden

Semicon Nordics is hiring on behalf of one of our clients.

Job Summary

We are seeking talented engineers to join a high-performing development team working on advanced RF and digital chip design for next-generation wireless communication systems. We welcome candidates with strengths in one or more of the following areas: RF/RFIC design, digital design, mmWave technologies, and digital beamforming.

    Design, simulate, and validate RF circuits and RFIC (Radio Frequency Integrated Circuit) systems for high-frequency, high-performance applications
    Develop digital logic and RTL implementations supporting RF/mmWave signal processing chains

    Collaborate closely with system architects, digital design engineers, and verification teams to ensure robust end-to-end chip and system performance
    Perform lab testing, characterization, and debugging of RF/mmWave hardware and prototypes
    Contribute to system-level architecture decisions balancing RF performance, power, and digital implementation constraints

Required Skills & Experience (relevant to your area of expertise)

    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to bridge RF and digital design domains
    Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

Preferred/Meritorious

    Experience with 5G, 6G, or advanced wireless connectivity products
    Experience with RFIC (Radio Frequency Integrated Circuit) design specifically
    Knowledge of antenna array systems and phased-array signal processing

📩 Interested candidates: please share your updated CV to prianka.raina@semiconservicenordic.com

title: Back Office & Tour Coordination Personnel
description:
Stockholm Adventures – Stockholm

Stockholm Adventures is looking for a motivated and organised Back Office & Tour Coordination person to join our team in Stockholm.

Stockholm Adventures is a tourism and adventure company offering a wide range of guided and self-guided experiences all year around, including bike tours, kayaking, nature adventures, boat tours, ice skating and rentals. Our goal is to create genuine, memorable experiences for our guests while maintaining a high level of service and operational quality.

About the Role

As a member of our back-office team, you will play an important role in making sure our daily operations run smoothly. You will work closely with the front office, guides and other members of the team to coordinate tours, manage bookings and support our guests before, during and after their experiences.

You will be involved in developing new tourism products, packages and tours, from the initial idea through to planning, coordination and implementation.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys working in tourism, is highly organised, takes initiative and is comfortable handling several tasks at the same time.

Main Responsibilities

    Support and oversee front-office operations and ensure guests receive excellent service.
    Coordinate daily tours and activities, including schedules, guides, participants and operational details.
    Monitor and manage bookings, changes, cancellations and customer requests.
    Ensure tour information is accurate and up to date across relevant systems.
    Communicate with guides, suppliers, partners and customers regarding tour logistics.
    Assist with daily scheduling and allocation of guides and resources.
    Handle administrative tasks related to tour operations and bookings.
    Help resolve operational issues and last-minute changes in a calm and efficient manner.
    Follow up on bookings and ensure all necessary information is communicated to the relevant team members.
    Participate in the development and creation of new tours, products and travel packages.
    Research and develop new tour concepts and experiences suitable for Stockholm Adventures' target markets.
    Assist with planning, pricing, scheduling and operational setup of new products and packages.
    Coordinate the implementation and launch of new tours and experiences.
    Contribute ideas for improving existing products, guest experiences and operational processes.
    Support the wider team with general administrative and operational tasks when required.
    Participate in the recruitment process for seasonal staff, including helping define staffing needs, reviewing applications, communicating with candidates and participating in interviews.
    Assist with onboarding and coordinating new seasonal employees and guides.



Requirements

    Previous professional experience in the tourism sector is required.
    Excellent organisational and administrative skills.
    Strong attention to detail and the ability to prioritise tasks.
    Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where plans can change quickly.
    Good communication and customer-service skills.
    Ability to work independently while also being an active part of a team.
    An interest in developing new tourism products and creating new guest experiences.
    Fluent English, both written and spoken. Swedish and/or other languages are an advantage.
    Good general computer skills.

Preferred

Experience with any of the following would be highly valuable:

    Booking and reservation systems, particularly FareHarbor or similar platforms.
    Administrative/accounting systems such as Fortnox.
    Staff scheduling and workforce planning systems.
    Tour or activity management software.
    Experience coordinating guides, drivers, suppliers or other operational staff.
    Experience developing, launching or managing tourism products, tours or packages.
    Knowledge of the Stockholm tourism market and local attractions and activities.
    Active life style and love for the outdoors.
    Driving license

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is reliable, proactive, solution-oriented and creative, with a genuine interest in tourism and creating great experiences for guests.

You should enjoy taking responsibility, keeping things organised and making sure that the details behind the scenes are taken care of.

The ideal candidate is comfortable switching between administrative work, customer service, operational coordination and product development throughout the day.

A positive attitude, flexibility and the ability to remain calm when things get busy are essential.

What We Offer

    A varied and hands-on role within Stockholm's tourism and adventure industry.
    The opportunity to work with a friendly and international team.
    A dynamic workplace where no two days are exactly the same.
    The opportunity to be involved in a wide range of tours and outdoor experiences.
    The opportunity to develop and launch new tourism products, tours and packages agreed within the back office team.
    Possibilities to develop your skills within tourism operations, administration and product development.

If you are interested in joining Stockholm Adventures, please send your CV and a cover letter with a short introduction about yourself and your relevant experience to info@stockholmadventures.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Global Product Manager
description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables.

Job description:

Do you want to help shape the future of autonomous mining and accelerate the transformation toward safer, more productive underground operations?







At Epiroc, we are expanding the boundaries of automation and digitalization, and we are looking for a commercially minded Global Product Manager who is passionate about turning customer needs into innovative business opportunities. This is a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of mining technology, driving the development and commercialization of advanced autonomous loader solutions used by customers around the world.







Join our team



You will join the Underground Division's Marketing organization and become part of a collaborative global team focused on Deep Automation solutions for underground loaders.







Working closely with colleagues across product management, R&D, sales, operations, and customer centers worldwide, you will contribute to some of Epiroc's most innovative and strategically important technologies.







Your Mission



Deep Automation combines advanced systems, software, and autonomous machines to create automation solutions for material handling in underground mining. As Global Product Manager, Deep Automation - Loaders, you will define, drive, and develop products and services that help customers improve safety, productivity, and operational performance through automation and digitalization.







You will be responsible for the entire product lifecycle—from identifying customer and market needs to developing business opportunities, driving commercialization, and ensuring successful market adoption. Working closely with customers and colleagues across R&D, sales, and operations, you will shape product strategy, develop business and pricing models, support marketing activities, train the global sales organization, and lead products from development through launch and continuous improvement.







Your responsibilities include:




    Defining product strategies and roadmaps based on customer and market insights.
    Identifying and developing new business opportunities and business cases.
    Driving product development, launch, and commercialization activities.
    Supporting global sales teams through training, value propositions, and marketing initiatives.
    Engaging directly with customers to understand needs and support their automation journey.
    Monitoring product performance and driving continuous improvements in safety, quality, and customer value.







Your Profile



We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded professional who enjoys identifying opportunities, influencing stakeholders, and turning ideas into successful products.You thrive in collaborative environments, excel at collaborating across a global and diverse organization, and are comfortable engaging with customers as well as technical experts.







To succeed in this role, you likely have:




    A university degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field.
    At least 5 years of experience in product management, business development, sales, project management, operations, or a similar commercial role.
    Experience working in industries such as mining, industrial automation, construction, robotics, manufacturing, or related sectors.
    Strong business acumen and the ability to identify, evaluate, and develop commercial opportunities.
    Experience working in cross-functional and international environments.
    Excellent communication and presentation skills in English.







Experience with automation, digital solutions, software-based products, or mining applications is considered an advantage. Fluency in Spanish is also considered a plus.







Location and Travel



This position is located in Örebro, Sweden.



We offer a flexible hybrid work environment that promotes a healthy balance between professional and personal life.



Occasional global travel is required.







Why Epiroc?



By joining our team, you can expect an atmosphere of creativity, innovation, and workplace diversity. You will be part of a skilled, positive, and ambitious team working in a creative environment shaped by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation. With colleagues from more than 100 nationalities, we offer a truly global and diverse workplace where continuous development is encouraged and supported.







To support your journey, we offer a competitive Total Rewards Package, including:




    Global career opportunities
    Learning & Development programs
    Benefits package, including variable compensation (bonus)
    Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being
    Global Parental Leave Policy
    Community involvement







Application and Contact Information



Please submit your application in English through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than October 14, 2026. Due to regulations, we cannot accept applications via email.







We are committed to a thorough recruitment process, including interviews, assessments, reference checks, identity verification, and drug and alcohol screening. Our process is designed to be fair, transparent, and inclusive.







For questions about the position, please contact: Hiring Manager: Mattias Pettersson - mattias.pettersson@epiroc.com







For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact: Recruitment Specialist: Diana Novakovicova – diana.novakovicova@epiroc.com

title: Doktorand inom idrottsvetenskap med inriktning management
description:
GIH utlyser härmed en doktorandplats i ämnet idrottsvetenskap, inom ämnesområdet management med inriktning hälsa och idrott. Doktoranden kommer att vara anställd vid Institutionen för rörelse, kultur och samhälle.

Projektbeskrivning:

Doktorandprojektet syftar till att stärka forskning om organisering, ledning, styrning och utveckling av idrotts- och hälsoverksamheter.

Detta kan studeras genom en kombination av kvalitativa och kvantitativa metoder utifrån ett flertal olika perspektiv såsom idrottsvetenskapliga-, hälsofrämjande-, historiska- samt organisations- och ledarskapsperspektiv.

Som en del av ansökan förväntas sökanden formulera en forskningsplan för ett doktorandprojekt som knyter an till hur organisering och ledning av idrott och/eller hälsa inom exempelvis civilsamhälle och kommersiell sektor förändras i relation till samhälleliga förändringsprocesser. Det kan handla om hur samhälleliga och/eller organisatoriska strukturer och beslutsfattande påverkar styrning, policyarbete och påverkansprocesser inom hälso- och idrottsområdet. Det kan även handla om hur idrotts- och hälsoorganisationer kan verka som främjare av exempelvis hälsa, hållbarhet och demokrati.

Projekt kan exempelvis fokusera på:

- hur den svenska idrottsmodellen förändras i relation till samhälleliga förändringsprocesser.

- på vilket sätt kunskap och forskning påverkar hur idrotts- och hälsoorganisationer styr och leder sin verksamhet.

- hur normer och värderingar på global och nationell nivå påverkar idrotts- och hälsoorganisationers styrning och ledning av sin verksamhet.

- hur olika typer av idrotts- och hälsoorganisationer samverkar med andra organisationer eller offentliga aktörer.

Handledning:  Isak Lidström & Susanna Geidne föreslås handleda doktoranden.

Behörighet till utbildning på forskarnivå

För att kunna antas till utbildning på forskarnivå i idrottsvetenskap krävs att den sökande har:

    avlagt en examen på avancerad nivå, fullgjort kursfordringar om minst 240 högskolepoäng, varav minst 60 högskolepoäng på avancerad nivå, eller på något annat sätt inom eller utom landet förvärvat motsvarande kunskaper
    den förmåga som i övrigt behövs för att klara utbildningen.

Gymnasiebetyg som motsvarar Engelska 6 är ett grundläggande krav.

Den grundläggande behörigheten ska vara uppfylld vid tiden för antagning till forskarutbildning, 1 december 2026.

Ansökan

Ansökan om antagning ska innehålla följande vidimerade handlingar i pdf-format:

    Examensbevis eller andra dokument som styrker behörigheten. Kopia på examensbevis ska bifogas på originalspråk samt i engelsk översättning av auktoriserad översättare (gäller ej svenska, danska, norska, engelska). Om studierna inte är avslutade vid ansökningstillfället ska den sökande även bifoga ett intyg utfärdat av utbildningsanordnaren som anger förväntat examensdatum,
    Intyg om behörighet motsvarande Engelska 6 från internationellt godkänt språktest: TOEFL, IELTS, ESOL (gäller sökande som inte har betyg från svenskt gymnasium eller en masterexamen från ett engelskspråkigt universitet eller program),
    Uppsats på avancerad nivå (magister- eller masteruppsats). Accepterade språk är svenska, danska, norska, engelska,
    Övriga publikationer (exempelvis examensarbeten på grundläggande nivå, publicerade artiklar eller manuskript),
    CV med en kort skriftlig motivering av ansökan utifrån utbildningsbakgrund,
    Förslag på minst två referenser varav en måste vara en tidigare chef,
    Projektplan på max 7000 tecken inklusive blanksteg.

http://www.gih.se/FORSKNING/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Ansokan-och-anstallning/Ansokan-till-forskarutbildning/.

Urval

Urval bland de sökande görs med hänsyn till förmågan att tillgodogöra sig utbildning på forskarnivå. En viktig bedömningsgrund utgör inriktning på högskolepoängen på avancerad nivå samt kvalitet på det självständiga arbetet på avancerad nivå. Bedömningen sker utifrån följande fastställda kriterier:

    förtrogenhet med för avhandlingsämnet relevanta förkunskaper inom områdena idrott, fysisk aktivitet, hälsa och management,
    teoretisk medvetenhet samt förtrogenhet med adekvata metoder,
    analytisk förmåga,
    förmåga till kritiskt tänkande och problemformulering,
    skriftlig och muntlig kommunikativ förmåga samt,
    förtrogenhet med etiska problemställningar.

Antagning och anställning

Bestämmelser för tillträde till utbildning på forskarnivå regleras i Högskoleförordningens 7 kap. samt i GIH:s antagningsordning. Bestämmelser för anställning som doktorand återfinns i högskoleförordnings 5 kap. Som innehavare av anställning som doktorand får enbart förordnas den som är antagen till utbildning på forskarnivå. Vid tillsättning ska avseende främst fästas vid graden av förmåga att tillgodogöra sig utbildningen.

Övriga villkor

För mer information om anställningarna som doktorand och utbildning på forskarnivå vid GIH hänvisas till http://www.gih.se/FORSKNING/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/.

För information om vad det innebär att vara anställd på GIH, se vår https://www.gih.se/Global/5_omGIH/Styrdokument/Administration/GIH_Medarbetarskaps-och_ledarskapspolicy_2015-04-07.pdf.

GIH verkar för mångfald och jämställdhet, vi ser därför gärna sökande med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter.

Varaktighet/Arbetstid

Tidsbegränsad anställning om fyra år på heltid (motsvarande 100 procents tjänstgöringsgrad) enligt högskoleförordningens 5 kap 1–7§ med tillträde senast december 2026 eller enligt överenskommelse.

Lön

Lönen regleras genom lokalt kollektivavtal.

Sista ansökningsdag

Ansökan ska vara GIH tillhanda senast den 22 oktober 2026. Detta är en förkortad annonsvariant, se fullständig annons här LÄNK



Åberopade meriter ska kunna intygas vid anmodan. GIH verkar för mångfald och jämställdhet inom samtliga anställningskategorier. Vi ser därför gärna sökande med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter. Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av platsannonser.

title: Butikssäljare med avdelningsansvar
description:
Är du vår nästa nyckelperson?

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet från livsmedelsbutik och vill ta nästa steg i karriären!

Vi söker en driven person som vill ta ett operativt och ledande ansvar för en av våra avdelningar. Exakt vilken avdelning det blir – t.ex färskvaror, frukt & grönt, mejeri eller annan avdelning – bestämmer vi tillsammans utifrån din erfarenhet och dina styrkor, samt butikens behov.

Vi söker dig som:

title: Global ESO Quality Specialist
description:
Global ESO Quality Specialist (Fixed Term 1-Year)

Primary Location: Uppsala, Sweden

At Galderma, we advance dermatology for every skin story. We are now looking for a dynamic and experienced QA Specialist to join our External Supplier Organization (ESO) for Sterile Products.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to work in a global environment, supporting world-leading brands such as Nemluvio and Sculptra while collaborating closely with external suppliers across the globe. As part of ESO, you will play a critical role in ensuring product quality, regulatory compliance, and the continuous improvement of our quality systems and processes.



Position Overview

We are seeking a Quality Assurance Specialist with 2–5 years of experience within the medical device, pharmaceutical, or other regulated industries. The ideal candidate will have expertise across various QA functions, including complaint management, release activities, sterile production, documentation management, and regulatory compliance.

The position is within the External Supplier Organization (ESO) for Sterile Products, and you will work closely with external manufacturing partners and suppliers to ensure the highest standards of quality and compliance throughout the product lifecycle.



Key Responsibilities

    Quality Systems

Contribute to the development, implementation, and maintenance of robust quality systems, including complaint management, deviation management, change control, CAPA, and risk management processes. The main responsibility within the Quality Management System (QMS) area will be complaint management.

    Release Activities

Execute product release activities in compliance with regulatory requirements and company standards. Ensure the timely and accurate release of pharmaceutical products for distribution.

    Sterile Production

Provide QA oversight for sterile manufacturing operations, including aseptic processing, sterilization processes, and environmental monitoring. Ensure adherence to cGMP guidelines, regulatory standards, and applicable ISO requirements.



    Documentation Management

Manage and review quality documentation, including batch records, standard operating procedures (SOPs), risk assessments, validation protocols, and reports. Ensure documentation complies with regulatory requirements, ISO 13485, MDR, and internal quality standards.



    Regulatory Compliance

Stay up to date with regulatory requirements and industry best practices related to quality assurance. Ensure ongoing compliance with FDA regulations, applicable ISO standards, MDR requirements, and company policies.

    Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities for process improvement and quality enhancement. Participate in quality improvement initiatives and projects aimed at optimizing quality systems and operational efficiency.



Required Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biology, or a related field.

· 2–5 years of experience in a Quality Assurance role within the medical device, pharmaceutical, or other regulated industry.

· Fluency in written and spoken English; additional languages are considered an advantage.

· Strong operational knowledge of medical device or pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, including the production of sterile biological drugs, terminally sterilized products, and/or aseptically filled products.

· Proficiency in documentation management.

· Familiarity with regulatory requirements, including cGMP, FDA regulations, ISO 13485, MDR, and international guidelines.

· Excellent communication skills.

· Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.



Preferred Qualifications

· Pharmacist degree or a Master’s degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Engineering, Microbiology, Life Sciences, or another relevant scientific or engineering discipline.

· Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.



What We Offer in Return

You will be working for an organization that embraces diversity and inclusion and believes that better outcomes are achieved by reflecting the perspectives of our diverse customer base.

Within the ESO organization, nearly 60 employees work together in a highly collaborative global environment supporting world-leading brands such as Nemluvio and Sculptra.

We offer the opportunity to work in an exciting international setting where both professional and personal development are encouraged. Our teams are based in modern offices across Europe, including Uppsala (Sweden), Alby (France), and Barcelona (Spain).

As you will be working closely with suppliers located across the globe, travel is an integral part of the position.

Who You Are

You are a resilient and quality-focused professional with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. You thrive in an international and collaborative environment, enjoy building relationships with internal and external stakeholders, and have a passion for ensuring compliance, product quality, and continuous improvement.

Your expertise and engagement will contribute significantly to Galderma's continued growth and success.

Our People Make a Difference

At Galderma, you’ll work with people who are like you—and people who are different. We value what every member of our team brings. Professionalism, collaboration, and a friendly, supportive culture create the perfect environment for people to thrive, develop, and excel in what they do.

Join us on this exciting journey and help shape the future of quality within Galderma's global External Supplier Organization.

title: Doktorand i medie- och kommunikationsvetenskap
description:
Arbetsuppgifter

Utbildning på forskarnivå omfattar fyra år på heltid och finansieras genom anställning som doktorand. Doktoranden förutsätts ägna sin huvudsakliga arbetstid åt utbildning på forskarnivå och förväntas aktivt delta i institutionens seminarieverksamhet, workshops, konferenser samt andra forskningsrelaterade aktiviteter som pågår vid institutionen. Andra uppgifter såsom undervisning och forskningsadministration – på engelska och/eller svenska – kan också ingå inom ramen för anställningen (max 20 %).

Doktoranden kommer att ingå i projektet Förtroliga samtal: AI-assisterade former för emotionellt stöd och personligt välbefinnande bland unga svenskar, finansierat av Vetenskapsrådet (Dnr 2026-00497). Inom projektet utforskas hur unga (15-18 år) tolkar och förhåller sig till AI som samtalspartner inom personliga livsområden, samt de möjligheter och utmaningar som traditionella vårdgivare upplever i relation till detta. Doktoranden förväntas planera och genomföra empiriska studier inom ramen för projektet, genom befintligt samarbete med Ungdomsmottagningarna i region Västmanland, och i samverkan med forskargruppen. Projektet leds av Matilda Tudor (PI), Medie- och Kommunikationsvetenskap, och Lina Eklund (co-PI), Människa- datorinteraktion; båda med forskningsprofiler inom normkritiska digitala mediestudier och vardagsautomation. Läs mer om projektet här.

Kvalifikationskrav

Behörig till utbildning på forskarnivå inom medie- och kommunikationsvetenskap är den som har:

    avlagt examen på avancerad nivå inom medie- och kommunikationsvetenskap, eller
    

fullgjort minst 240 högskolepoäng, varav minst 90 högskolepoäng på avancerad nivå inklusive ett självständigt arbete om minst 15 högskolepoäng inom medie- och kommunikationsvetenskap, eller

    på något annat sätt förvärvat i huvudsak motsvarande kunskaper.

Vi söker en kandidat med ett starkt intresse för ungas livssituation och ny teknik. Kandidaten ska ha dokumenterad erfarenhet av att arbeta med forskningsrelaterade uppgifter inom medie- och kommunikationsvetenskap, till exempel genom att ha genomfört ett arbete på avancerad nivå. Kandidaten ska ha dokumenterad erfarenhet av att arbeta med intervjumetod och/eller enkäter, och måste kunna utföra kvalitativa forskningsintervjuer på svenska. Därmed krävs flytande färdigheter i svenska språket, samt excellenta kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid kandidatens personliga lämplighet för tjänsten och intresse för ämnet. Förutom akademiska meriter är viktiga kvalifikationer samarbetsförmåga, initiativförmåga, självständighet och ett kritiskt, reflekterande och analytiskt förhållningssätt. Även personliga förmågor bör styrkas genom dokumentation.

När universitetet anställer nya doktorander ska de sökande väljas som efter en kvalitativ helhetsbedömning av kompetens och skicklighet bedöms ha de bästa förutsättningarna att genomföra och utveckla aktuella arbetsuppgifter, särskilt inom det aktuella doktorandprojektet, samt bidra till en positiv utveckling av verksamheten inom området.

Meriterna ska vara dokumenterade så att såväl kvalitet som omfattning kan bedömas.

Intervjuer kommer att hållas via fysisk eller digital intervju på Uppsala universitet.

Bestämmelser för doktorander återfinns i Högskoleförordningen 5 kap §§ 1-7 samt i universitetets regler och riktlinjer.

Ansökan ska innehålla:

    

Kort följebrev som ska innehålla,1) Den sökandes motiv till att söka tjänsten (max 500 ord), 2) En kort beskrivning av de dokument som skickats med (lista dem), 3) Om mer än ett akademiskt arbete (uppsats, artikel etc.) lämnats till bedömning ska det i följebrevet anges vilket av dessa som antagningskommittén ska prioritera

    Avhandlingsplan (två sidor max., på engelska). Planen ska innehålla teoretisk ansats, forskningsfrågor, syfte, typ av data, metod samt tidsplan
    

CV med bestyrkta kopior av akademiska dokument, t. ex. registerutdrag, som styrker behörighet till utbildning på forskarnivå i medie- och kommunikationsvetenskap samt kopia av vidimerade kopior av examensbevis och betyg

    Två rekommendationsbrev
    

Kopia av de självständiga arbeten som sökanden författat inom ramen för sin grundutbildning (C-, D-, avancerad nivå eller motsvarande; bifoga utkast av pågående arbeten) alternativt andra relevanta texter

    Andra dokument som den sökande önskar bifoga

NOTERA: Ofullständig ansökan kommer ej beaktas.

Om anställningen

Anställningen är tidsbegränsad, enligt HF 5 kap § 7. Omfattningen är heltid. Tillträde 1 januari eller enligt överenskommelse. Placeringsort: Uppsala

Upplysningar om anställningen lämnas av:

    Projektledare - Matilda Tudor, matilda.tudor@im.uu.se
    Prefekt – Tomas Eklund, tomas.eklund@im.uu.se
    Ämnesföreträdare Medie- och Kommunikationsvetenskap - Michał Krzyżanowski, michal.krzyzanowski@im.uu.se

Uppsala universitet är ett brett forskningsuniversitet med stark internationell ställning. Det yttersta målet är att bedriva utbildning och forskning av högsta kvalitet och relevans för att göra skillnad i samhället. Vår viktigaste tillgång är alla 7 500 anställda och 53 000 studenter som med nyfikenhet och engagemang gör Uppsala universitet till en av landets mest spännande arbetsplatser.
