title: Senior Digital Designer
description:
About Nordic Air Defence

Nordic Air Defence, headquartered in Stockholm, develops cutting-edge defensive solutions for both civilian and military applications. We combine expertise in electronics, mechanical design, embedded systems, software engineering, and AI.

In September 2024, Nordic Air Defence unveiled its first product, the Kreuger 100, a dual-use drone-interceptor platform engineered in Sweden by a diverse, international team. Today, our employees represent more than 12 nationalities, creating a dynamic and collaborative environment where different perspectives drive innovation.

Our engineers and operators bring experience from leading defence, drone, and technology organisations worldwide, including Palantir, Kratos, Saab, Anduril, and others.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Digital Designer to help build and evolve the visual identity of Nordic Air Defence across digital, physical, and commercial touchpoints.

This is a hands-on senior design role for someone with extensive professional experience, exceptional visual judgment, strong systems thinking, and the ability to quickly translate creative direction into distinctive, highly polished work. You will work closely with our Creative Director and Head of Brand across brand identity, brand system, web experiences, product communications, presentations, and other key brand applications.

The role requires both conceptual strength and executional excellence. You should be comfortable moving between high-level visual ideas and detailed production work in a fast-moving environment while helping to build a coherent design system that can scale with the company as we continue to grow.

Key Responsibilities

As a Senior Digital Designer, you will:

    

Develop Nordic Air Defence's visual identity across digital, physical, and commercial applications together with the Creative Director.

    

Design and maintain scalable brand systems, templates, and visual guidelines.

    

Create high-quality design assets for web, presentations, marketing materials, product communication, and internal initiatives.

    

Translate creative direction into polished and impactful visual solutions and complete visual systems.

    

Develop and refine typography, layouts, grids, and visual frameworks.

    

Collaborate closely with the Creative Director and Head of Brand to ensure consistency across all touchpoints.

    

Contribute to the development of digital experiences, including websites, user interfaces, and responsive design solutions.

    

Help establish design processes and systems that support long-term growth and scalability.

Requirements

Brand & Visual Identity

    

Experience designing logos and identity systems.

    

Strong concept development and ideation skills.

    

Expertise in typography, layout, and grid systems.

    

Experience creating and implementing brand applications.

    

Ability to build and maintain templates and brand libraries.

Digital & Web

    

Strong experience in web and responsive design.

    

UX/UI design expertise.

    

Familiarity with CMS platforms and low-code web implementation.

    

Understanding of front-end development principles.

Communication & Content Design

    

Experience creating presentations and information design materials.

    

Ability to communicate technical, informational, and commercial content visually.

    

Experience designing across multiple channels and platforms.

    

Strong systems thinking around the work.

Nice to have

    

Motion design, 3D design, or product visualization experience using tools such as Unreal Engine, Cinema 4D, or Blender.

    

Familiarity with CAD workflows or manufacturing processes.

    

Experience in interactive or immersive web design.

    

Product and physical brand design experience, including CMF, product graphics, or product marking.

    

Experience from the defence, aerospace, robotics, or advanced technology sectors.

    

Strong sketching and rapid visual ideation capabilities.

Personal Qualities – We are looking for someone who:

    

Produces consistently high-quality work with exceptional attention to detail.

    

Demonstrates excellent visual judgment and a strong design portfolio.

    

Combines creative thinking with systems-oriented problem-solving.

    

Thrives when collaborating closely with creative leadership and stakeholders.

    

Is comfortable receiving direct feedback and iterating toward the best solution based on the creative direction provided.

    

Takes ownership, is proactive and self-sufficient when needed, and works well in a small, ambitious team.

    

Remains patient, adaptable, and persistent in a fast-moving environment.

    

Is committed to continuous improvement and refinement.

    

Handles sensitive and confidential information with integrity and professionalism.

Additionally

Form of employment: Full-time with an initial 6-month probation period Start date: ASAP Location: Solna Strand, Stockholm Reporting to: Creative Director & Head of Brand Work permit: You are a citizen of a NATO country and have a legal right to work in Sweden.

Compliance & Background Check: As a company operating in the defence industry, Nordic Air Defence is subject to Swedish and international regulatory requirements. A background check will be conducted for the final candidate as part of the recruitment process.

title: Corporate Communications Specialist – Change & Internal communications
description:
Company Description

AFRY provides engineering, project management, and advisory services that enable the energy and industrial transition and strengthen resilience in society. With 18,000 experts worldwide, we combine a global reach with local insights and deep sector knowledge to make a lasting impact for generations to come.

Our shared principles - Results driven, Client Centric, Empowering and Accountable - guide us in how we work, grow and succeed together.

Job Description

We are looking for a Corporate Communications Specialist with a focus on change and internal communications.

You will report to the Head of Corporate Communications, based in Solna, Sweden, and be part of an engaged, skilled and truly global team of communicators, as well as the broader Commercial & Communications team.

You will primarily focus on communications in operational change processes involving multiple stakeholders across AFRY. Initially, your main responsibility will be to support change communications for one of our business-critical processes. You will act as a sounding board to the Change Communications Lead and be responsible for producing clear and engaging communication materials in English, including presentations, articles and film scripts.

You will also interact with many other stakeholders involved in this process, which will eventually impact all AFRY employees.

The Corporate Communications Specialist role may also include other tasks within internal communications, such as editorial work, supporting leaders, and providing translations of global marketing and communications material into local languages

Qualifications

This role is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys collaborating across borders and functions, contributing experiences and perspectives, and growing together with skilled communications colleagues in one of Europe's leading engineering and advisory companies, where we help our clients accelerate the transition to a more sustainable society.

Required Experience

    Bachelor's degree in Communications, Business Administration or another relevant field
    A few years’ experience in internal and change communications
    A few years’ experience working in a large, complex (group/divisions) organization
    Experience creating communication materials and content in corporate English, including articles, presentations and other communication assets for different internal audiences and channels
    Ability to plan communication activities based on target audiences, channel selection, timing and frequency
    Experience with Microsoft 365, particularly PowerPoint and SharePoint
    Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

Beneficial Experience

    Master's degree in Communications, Business Administration or another relevant field
    Experience working with change communications in digital transformation initiatives, adoption activities or project communications
    Experience from consulting or advisory environments, particularly within engineering, technology or innovation-driven sectors
    Proficiency in German

Personal Competencies

    Strong communication skills with the ability to make complex topics simple, clear and engaging for different audiences

title: Technical Lead, MFT / EDI-integration (IBM Sterling)
description:

    Experience with EDI mapping (Sterling Map Editor) in X12 and EDIFACT.
    Strong knowledge of SFTP, FTPS, FTP, AS2 and Connect:Direct.
    Java, SQL, XML and XSLT.
    Experience with databases (DB2, SQL Server, Oracle) and Windows and Linux.
    Experience with 24/7 production support in SLA-governed environments.

title: Fixed Asset Register (FAR) Controller to industrial company-Sthlm or Boden
description:
Are you a detail-oriented finance professional with a strong understanding of engineering and project controls? Do you excel at bridging the gap between physical assets and financial records in large-scale projects? Then this might be something for you!

About the position

Perido is looking for a Fixed Asset Register (FAR) Controller on behalf of our client, a pioneering industrial enterprise driving large-scale green energy and manufacturing initiatives. In this role, you will play a crucial part in ensuring that major project expenditures are correctly identified, classified, and recorded as assets in accordance with regulatory and accounting standards. You will act as the vital link between Project Controls, Finance, and Engineering. The position is based in either Stockholm or Boden, with the possibility of working remotely at ca 50%.

Your daily tasks

As a FAR Controller, you will treat the Fixed Asset Register as a controlled financial record, ensuring every material asset and associated cost is traceable and audit-ready. Your main tasks will include:

    Maintain and regularly reconcile the FAR against project cost records, commitments, invoices, and approved asset structures
    Collaborate closely with Engineering to identify, describe, and allocate equipment, systems, tag numbers, asset hierarchy, and commissioning status
    Track assets through procurement, construction, installation, commissioning, and handover to reflect real-time physical status
    Identify operational assets and coordinate with Finance for timely capitalisation and commencement of depreciation
    Ensure proper cost allocation across equipment, installation, engineering, and directly attributable costs
    Identify and resolve discrepancies between the FAR, cost systems, procurement records, and engineering data
    Maintain a robust audit trail for asset values, classifications, adjustments, and capitalisation decisions
    Support periodic physical verification of assets with Engineering and Operations
    Produce regular FAR completeness and reconciliation reports, escalating any gaps that could compromise compliance

Your characteristics

We are looking for someone who takes full ownership of financial controls and approaches asset tracking with precision and analytical rigor. You are a collaborative communicator who seamlessly bridges technical engineering insights with strict accounting compliance. You understand that the FAR is not just an administrative schedule, but a critical, controlled financial record.

Is this the challenge you are looking for? We welcome your application today!

In this recruitment process, we only accept applications written in English.

Qualifications:

    Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Engineering, or equivalent relevant background
    Proven experience in fixed asset control, capital expenditure (CapEx) accounting, or project controls within large-scale industrial/engineering projects
    Strong proficiency in financial ERP systems, project cost controls software, and Excel.
    Fluent in spoken and written English

Meritorious:

    Experience working in complex industrial, energy, or manufacturing construction environments
    Deep familiarity with regulatory accounting policies and internal/external audit standards regarding fixed assets

Contract type and hours

Full-time consulting assignment until 2027-01-31. Start 2026-10-13.

Let us help you take the next step in your career

Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. With us, you will find a wide variety of assignments, where you can either be employed directly by a company or work as a consultant through Perido. We are one of Sweden’s largest consulting firms for professionals, which gives you many opportunities. As a consultant, you become an important part of our organization and contribute your expertise within our clients’ organizations. Read more about us at Perido: https://perido.se/om-oss/

You can find answers to most questions or concerns at perido.se/vanliga-fragor/. If you still cannot find what you are looking for, you are welcome to contact us at fraga@perido.se. Please always include the position reference number 36026 in the subject line. Please note that we only accept applications through our website and that we are unable to provide updates on your application status or disclose the client company if it is not stated in the job advertisement.

Software Architect 80 \- 100% (m/f/d)
=====================================

Your task

* Work upstream in the requirements process (PRD), establishing what each option costs to build and to run, what it commits us to later, and which one holds up once the commercial, medical and regulatory constraints are applied.
* Align architecture, security and data residency decisions with our internal Compliance team.
* Advise on which stack, pattern or vendor fits a given component or platform across Medgate's ecosystem, weighing each case on its own merits, with the incumbent stack as one option among several.
* Run cross\-team design and architecture reviews that catch coupling, duplicated logic and inconsistencies between modules or projects before they harden into technical debt, independently of any single product owner's roadmap.
* Establish which build\-or\-buy options genuinely remain once vendor delivery model, data residency and existing licences have narrowed the field \- and what each one costs to live with.
* Challenge existing architecture choices when a new problem's context calls for a fresh answer \- and confirm them where they still hold, once actually tested against the new case.
* Maintain a lightweight, living set of shared technical standards and decision records, so settled trade\-offs stay settled from one project to the next.
* Act as the technical counterpart for integration partners, from first feasibility discussion through to a working integration.
* Advise engineering leadership and product owners on scalability, integration risk and platform\-level consequences ahead of major initiatives, in terms a business stakeholder can weigh in on.
* Take a system\-level view of where and how Medgate's AI\-assisted engineering workflow ( Code and its multi\-agent pipeline) should evolve across teams and repositories, distinct from any one team's day\-to\-day use of it.




Your profile

Must have

* 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including a genuine track record in architecture or cross\-team technical leadership roles.
* Hands\-on\-enough background in modern backend and web stacks (.NET/EF Core, React\-based SPAs) to credibly challenge concrete implementation choices, while implementation itself stays with the teams.
* Solid experience with server\-side GraphQL, including schema composition.
* Working command of data and analytics, data flows, cloud infrastructure (Azure), infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform) and security. Enough to hold a defensible position in each, across five teams with distinct technology profiles.
* Experience identifying and resolving architectural drift and duplicated patterns across teams (e.g. two teams solving the same problem in two different ways) and turning that into a remediation call that was actually carried out.
* Fluent English, spoken and written. or French is a strong advantage.
* Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.




Nice to have

* Hands\-on experience with HotChocolate (ChilliCream).
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted engineering workflows.
* Experience with Genesys or another telephony / contact\-center integration.
* Experience shaping how agentic / AI\-assisted engineering workflows (skills, multi\-agent pipelines, review gates) should be governed across multiple teams.
* Experience in healthcare, insurance or another highly regulated industry, where architecture decisions carry direct GDPR/nLPD/HIPAA\-type consequences \- including first\-hand experience negotiating design constraints with a compliance function.




Your benefits with Medgate

* Work on meaningful projects that help shape the future of digital healthcare.
* Modern cloud\-native technology stack including Azure Databricks, dbt, Power BI and AI\-powered engineering tools.
* Hybrid working model with two office days per week (Tuesday and Wednesday) and flexible remote working on the remaining days.
* High level of ownership and the opportunity to actively shape our growing data platform.
* Collaborative, international working environment with short decision\-making paths.
* Continuous learning opportunities and access to modern technologies.

**Deine Aufgaben**

Kommunikation bedeutet weit mehr als Sprache. Sie bedeutet Teilhabe, Selbstbestimmung und Lebensqualität. Genau dafür setzt du dich mit deinem Team jeden Tag ein. Gemeinsam sorgt ihr dafür, dass Menschen mit Beeinträchtigungen die passende Unterstützung erhalten und ihren Alltag möglichst selbstbestimmt gestalten können. Dabei übernimmst du die Leitung des Fachbereichs «Unterstützte Kommunikation», führst ein selbstständiges Team von sieben Logopädinnen und trägst die personelle Verantwortung. Der Schwerpunkt deiner Arbeit liegt in der fachlichen Beratung und Begleitung von Menschen mit Beeinträchtigungen und deren Umfeld. Du bereitest Gespräche vor, führst Abklärungen durch und beurteilst vor Ort, welche Kommunikationshilfsmittel die grösstmögliche Teilhabe ermöglichen und von der Sozialversicherung nach deren Kriterien finanziert werden. Auf Basis deiner Einschätzungen erstellst du fundierte Fachberichte für Sozialversicherungen und weitere Auftraggeber. Dabei bewegst du dich täglich an der Schnittstelle zwischen Logopädie, Pädagogik, Medizin, Sozialversicherungen und Technologie. Du berätst Institutionen bei der nachhaltigen Implementierung von Kommunikationshilfsmitteln, tauschst dich mit Fachpersonen aus unterschiedlichsten Disziplinen aus und bringst dein Wissen aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung des Fachbereichs ein.

**Das bringst Du mit**

* Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Logopädin (EDK\-anerkannt)
* Freude daran, Menschen, Institutionen und Fachpersonen zu beraten und zu begleiten
* Interesse an technischen Hilfsmitteln und digitalen Lösungen
* Hohe Sozialkompetenz, Durchsetzungsvermögen und Organisationsgeschick
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und Französischkenntnisse (interner Gebrauch)
* Sowie einen gültigen Führerausweis Kategorie B


**Das erwartet Dich bei der SAHB**

Vergiss starre Bürozeiten und fixe Arbeitsorte. Bei der SAHB arbeitest du dort, wo es für dich und deine Termine am sinnvollsten ist: von zu Hause aus, unterwegs oder an einem der Standorte in der ganzen Schweiz. Freue dich auf eine aussergewöhnlich flexible Tätigkeit mit viel Eigenverantwortung, flachen Hierarchien und einer offenen Unternehmenskultur, die von Vertrauen, Wertschätzung und direkter Kommunikation geprägt ist.

Darüber hinaus profitierst du von attraktiven Rahmenbedingungen:

* Mindestens fünf Wochen Ferien, ab 50 Jahren sechs Wochen und ab 60 Jahren sieben Wochen Ferien sowie zusätzlich mindestens zwölf bezahlte Feiertage pro Jahr
* Flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein grosszügiges Gleitzeitmodell
* Attraktive Sozialleistungen mit überdurchschnittlicher Beteiligung des Arbeitgebers
* Lohnfortzahlung bei Krankheit und Unfall zu 100% sowie teilweise Übernahme der Taggeldprämie
* Halbtax\-Abonnement, kostenlose Parkplätze und Beteiligung an der Telefonrechnung oder ein Firmenhandy
* Grosszügige Unterstützung bei Sprachkursen und regelmässige Weiterbildungen
* Ein engagiertes und erfahrenes Team, das dich sorgfältig einarbeitet und jederzeit unterstützt


Das und viele weitere Benefits warten auf dich. Denn dich erwartet keine klassische Logopädie\-Stelle, sondern eine schweizweit einzigartige Aufgabe mit fachlicher Verantwortung, viel Freiheit und der Möglichkeit, Menschen nachhaltig zu unterstützen.

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Langzeitpflege Demenz 80-100% für die Region Egg gesucht
description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Egg sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Langzeitpflege Demenz.

### Auf einen Blick: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für die Region Egg

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Langzeitpflege Demenz

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Egg

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Egg liegt in der Nähe von Zürich und besticht durch eine ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung mit Bahn- und Busverbindungen. Die Region bietet Ihnen ein gutes Gleichgewicht zwischen ländlicher Ruhe und Nähe zur Metropole. Arbeitgeber profitieren von der zentralen Lage, dem gut ausgebildeten Arbeitskräfteangebot und der hohen Lebensqualität für Ihre Mitarbeiter.

### Diese Tätigkeiten erwarten Sie in Egg

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihre Stärken für diese Stelle

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Langzeitpflege Demenz

Die Demenzbetreuung arbeitet person-zentriert: Im Mittelpunkt steht der Mensch mit seiner Biografie. Sie gestalten deshalb einen Alltag mit festen Ritualen sowie vertrauten Handgriffen, erkennen nonverbale Signale und begegnen Unruhe mit Ruhe.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege Demenz in Egg verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen in der Langzeitpflege und Demenzbetreuung in der Region Egg verzeichnet eine hohe Nachfrage, da die Bevölkerung altert und spezialisierte Fachkräfte knapp sind. Ihre Qualifikation öffnet Ihnen Türen zu attraktiven Positionen bei etablierten Institutionen, die flexible Pensenmodelle zwischen 80-100% anbieten. iPersonal als erfahrener Vermittler kennt die lokalen Arbeitgeber genau und kann Ihnen gezielt passende Stellen zuführen, wodurch Ihr Einstieg in die Region deutlich vereinfacht wird.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Egg

- Bezahlte Kurse über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege Demenz in Egg

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**

* Hochschul\- oder Fachhochschulabschluss oder gleichwertige Ausbildung
* Ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten sowie vernetztes und strategisches Denkvermögen

Als Teil des Teams arbeitest du an zentralen strategischen Fragestellungen an der Schnittstelle von militärischer und unternehmerischer Entwicklung. Content \& Digital Marketing Manager – 50 %
=============================================

**Origami Rénovation – Canton de Vaud**

Origami Rénovation accompagne ses clients dans leurs projets de rénovation, de la conception à la réalisation des travaux.

Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons une personne créative, autonome et orientée résultats pour prendre en charge notre **marketing digital et la création de contenu**.

Il s’agit d’un poste très opérationnel : nous recherchons quelqu’un capable à la fois de **développer notre visibilité et notre acquisition en ligne** et de se rendre sur nos projets pour **créer des contenus photo et vidéo de qualité**.

Vos missions
------------

### Acquisition digitale \& Ads

* Concevoir, lancer et optimiser nos campagnes  **Ads – Instagram \& Facebook**
* Créer les audiences, campagnes et contenus publicitaires
* Suivre les performances : leads, coût par lead, taux de conversion, ROAS
* régulièrement de nouveaux formats, messages et audiences
* Participer à l'amélioration des landing pages et du parcours de conversion

* Suivre l'évolution du trafic organique et des positions
* Participer à l'amélioration continue du site et de ses performances


### Réseaux sociaux

* Définir et gérer le calendrier éditorial

* Imaginer des contenus adaptés à notre univers : architecture, rénovation, design et coulisses des chantiers
* Publier et décliner les contenus selon les différents formats : Reels, Stories, carrousels, posts, avant/après, etc.
* Développer la visibilité et l'engagement organiques de la marque


### Photo \& vidéo

* Se déplacer régulièrement sur nos chantiers et projets
* Filmer les différentes étapes d'une rénovation
* Réaliser des interviews, témoignages clients et prises de parole
* Photographier les projets, matériaux, détails et réalisations
* Monter les vidéos et créer des formats courts adaptés aux réseaux sociaux

Vous êtes avant tout un profil **polyvalent et très opérationnel**.

Vous savez aussi bien analyser les performances d'une campagne que prendre une caméra pour produire un beau contenu sur un chantier.

* Expérience concrète en  **Ads**
* Bonne maîtrise du **SEO**

La connaissance de **WordPress**, des outils d'analyse web et de l'univers de l'architecture, de l'immobilier ou du design constitue un vrai plus.

Ce que nous recherchons surtout
-------------------------------

Nous ne cherchons pas uniquement quelqu'un qui « poste sur les réseaux sociaux ».

Nous cherchons une personne capable de comprendre notre activité, d'en extraire les bonnes histoires et de transformer nos projets en **contenus qui renforcent la marque, développent notre visibilité et génèrent de nouvelles opportunités commerciales**.

Data Engineer — Analytics Platform
====================================

**Working place: Allschwil and Home\- Office**

For 26 years, Medgate has been bringing doctors directly to patients 24/7 thanks to telemedicine. At Medgate Switzerland, more than 300 motivated employees \- including over 130 permanently employed doctors \- are actively shaping the medicine of tomorrow with the help of future\-oriented digital health solutions.

Those who treat patients remotely at Medgate receive intensive training in telemedicine at the beginning. The medical guidelines developed for the needs of telemedicine and continuously refined over the years are practice\-oriented and designed for remote treatment. The patient management system supports doctors in their treatment by using artificial intelligence, among other things. This means that doctors have less administrative work and can focus more specifically on their patients. The medicine of the future is already a reality at Medgate.

With flexible working models and reliable duty scheduling, Medgate makes it easy to combine work, leisure and family life.



About the role

At Medgate, data plays a key role in shaping the future of healthcare. As a **Data Engineer**, you'll design, build and operate our modern cloud data platform, enabling reliable insights for internal teams and customer\-facing solutions.

You'll work with Azure Databricks, dbt and Power BI to transform data into valuable products while helping drive the evolution of our platform from a legacy Data Vault architecture to a modern dimensional (Kimball) model. Working closely with your team, you'll combine technical excellence with AI\-powered engineering practices to deliver scalable, high\-quality data solutions.



**Your tasks**

* Design, build and operate scalable data pipelines using Azure Data Factory and Databricks (batch and streaming).
* Develop and maintain robust dimensional data models (Kimball) using dbt within a modern bronze/silver/gold medallion architecture.
* Create and maintain semantic models, dashboards and reports in Power BI for internal stakeholders and external customers.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate data requirements into reliable and scalable technical solutions.
* Own your data products end\-to\-end, ensuring high quality, documentation, monitoring and operational excellence.
* Contribute to infrastructure as code (Terraform), CI/CD processes and code reviews to continuously improve our platform.
* Ensure high standards of data quality, consistency and governance across all data products and pipelines, including the secure handling of sensitive data.
* Use AI tools such as as an integral part of your daily engineering workflow to accelerate development, improve quality and solve complex data challenges.




**Your profile**

**Must\-have**

* **Fluent English and French (spoken and written). is a strong advantage.**
* **5\+ years of professional experience as a Data Engineer or in a comparable role.**
* **Hands\-on experience with dbt and modern data transformation practices.**
* **Experience working with AI\-powered development tools (e.g. , ChatGPT or GitHub Copilot) to increase engineering productivity.**
* Solid SQL skills and experience building reliable data pipelines.
* A degree in Computer Science, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.


**Nice to have**

* Experience with Azure Databricks and Azure Data Factory.
* Knowledge of dimensional data modelling (Kimball) and medallion architecture.
* Experience building semantic models, reports and DAX in Power BI.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with Unity Catalog or comparable data governance solutions.
* experience for data engineering or automation.
* Experience working with Data Vault environments.
* Experience deploying or supporting machine learning solutions in production.
* Experience in healthcare, insurance or other highly regulated industries.




**Your benefits with Medgate**

Technical Specialist – Life Sciences
======================================







For one of our clients, a leading company in the Life Sciences sector, we are currently looking for a **Technical Specialist \- Genomics / qPCR** to strengthen its commercial team in Switzerland.



This position is ideal for a candidate with a **strong scientific background** who would like to combine technical expertise with customer interaction and business development. You will work with a broad range of customers across Switzerland, including research institutions, laboratories, healthcare organizations and Life Sciences companies.



Technical Specialist – Life Sciences
======================================



Your Responsibilities
---------------------



As a Technical Specialist Genomics / qPCR, you will be responsible for developing and managing customer relationships while providing scientific and technical expertise on the company’s solutions.



Your main responsibilities will include:



* Develop sales activities and identify new business opportunities across the Swiss market.  
* Manage the full sales cycle, from initial customer contact and needs assessment through presentations, demonstrations, quotations and closing.  
* Understand customers’ scientific and technical requirements and translate them into appropriate solutions.  
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing customers while identifying additional business opportunities.  
* Provide technical and scientific support during customer discussions.  
* Organize and participate in customer meetings, workshops, product demonstrations and training sessions.  
* Work closely with internal sales, application and product specialists.  
* Maintain accurate information regarding customers, opportunities and commercial activities within the CRM.  
* Monitor market developments, competitors and emerging customer needs.  
* Participate in seminars, exhibitions, congresses and other industry events when required.  


Your Profile
------------



*  **Strong scientific background in Life Sciences**; a Master's degree or equivalent scientific qualification is preferred.  
* Several years of laboratory or technical experience within the Life Sciences field.  
*  **Very good knowledge of PCR technologies**, ideally including **qPCR and/or ddPCR**.  
* knowledge and understanding of **immunology / immunohematology** and related laboratory technologies.  
* At least a **first experience in sales, technical sales or a customer\-facing commercial position** within Life Sciences.  
* Ability to understand complex scientific applications and discuss them confidently with technical customers.  
* Strong communication, presentation and relationship\-building skills.  
* Commercial mindset with the ability to identify and develop business opportunities.  
*  **Fluent and English are mandatory.**  
*  **French is highly desirable** and will be considered a strong asset.  
* Comfortable working independently in a remote environment and travelling to customers when required.  
* Valid driving licence.  


The Opportunity
---------------



This is a **permanent position offering 100% remote work**, with the opportunity to combine **science, technology and sales** in a highly specialized Life Sciences environment.



You will have significant autonomy in your role while remaining closely connected to a multidisciplinary team and customers throughout Switzerland.

Die Staatsanwaltschaft ist für die Durchsetzung des staatlichen Strafanspruchs verantwortlich. Sie leitet das Vorverfahren, verfolgt die Straftaten im Rahmen von Untersuchungen, erhebt gegebenenfalls Anklage und vertritt diese Anklage vor Gericht. In geringfügigeren Fällen erlässt sie einen Strafbefehl. Organisatorisch besteht die Staatsanwaltschaft des Kantons Bern aus der Generalstaatsanwaltschaft, drei Staatsanwaltschaften für das ganze Kantonsgebiet (eine Staatsanwaltschaft für die Verfolgung von Wirtschaftsdelikten, eine für besondere Aufgaben und eine für Jugendstrafsachen), sowie vier regionalen Staatsanwaltschaften (Berner Jura\-Seeland, Emmental\-Oberaargau, Bern\-Mittelland und Oberland).

Dans un contexte de structuration de notre Customer Journey, nous recherchons un(e) :



**Business Analyst**  

GLOBAZ SA est engagée dans une transformation ambitieuse de son modèle opérationnel, de sa culture et de sa relation client. Notre ambition : passer d'une logique de fournisseur de services à une logique de partenaire stratégique créateur de valeur.

Nos clients ne nous évaluent pas sur nos intentions. Ils nous évaluent sur la qualité de l'expérience vécue, notre capacité à comprendre leurs enjeux, notre proactivité et notre réactivité, notre capacité à résoudre leurs « irritations », et notre capacité à contribuer concrètement à leur succès.

Ce rôle clé contribue à améliorer concrètement l'expérience client, à réduire les frictions, à accélérer la résolution des « problèmes » et à renforcer durablement la valeur créée pour nos clients.

**Ton rôle**

Le Business Analyst recueille et analyse les besoins des clients, qu’il s’agisse d’identifier des faiblesses ou opportunités d’amélioration des processus métier, de faire évoluer les structures organisationnelles ou de répondre à des enjeux informatiques. Il les challenge, les formalise en exigences claires et structurées, puis identifie les différentes possibilités d’implémentation en solutions informatiques.

Il intervient notamment dans des projets de digitalisation et d’automatisation des processus métier, ainsi que dans des activités de maintenance et de développement de solutions logicielles.

Au quotidien, le Business Analyst travaille en étroite collaboration avec les Project Managers (PM), Product Owners (PO), équipes IT et parties prenantes métier. Il veille à créer une compréhension commune des besoins et à assurer le lien entre les attentes métier et leur traduction en solutions technologiques.

En résumé, le Business Analyst est un véritable facilitateur de la transformation : il comprend les enjeux, pose les bonnes questions, structure les besoins et contribue à transformer les idées en solutions à valeur ajoutée.

***Comprendre et recueillir les besoins :***

***Analyser et challenger les besoins** :*

* Analyser les besoins des parties prenantes internes et externes

description:
Institutions autonomes de droit public, les Fonds cantonaux de compensation des allocations familiales et de l’assurance\-maternité jouent un rôle central dans le dispositif genevois des assurances sociales. Placés sous la surveillance du département de la cohésion sociale (DCS), ils contribuent à assurer l’équilibre et la solidarité de ces régimes en centralisant leurs flux financiers, en constituant et gérant leurs réserves et en assurant la gestion de leur fortune. À ce titre, ils veillent notamment au financement des prestations et au placement des avoirs dans une perspective de sécurité, de pérennité et de rendement.

Au cœur d’un écosystème institutionnel complexe, les Fonds entretiennent des relations étroites avec près d’une centaine de caisses de compensation, les partenaires sociaux et les autorités cantonales et fédérales.

Afin de succéder à l’actuelle titulaire qui fera prochainement valoir ses droits à la retraite, les Fonds cantonaux de compensation des allocations familiales et de l’assurance\-maternité recherchent leur prochain·e



**Directeur/Directrice général·e 100%**  

Rattaché·e à leurs Conseils d’administration, vous assumez la responsabilité globale des deux Fonds et contribuez à leurs orientations stratégiques. Vous en assurez la représentation auprès de leurs différents partenaires et disposez d’une large autonomie dans l’exercice de votre fonction.

**Vos principales responsabilités**

Dans un environnement en constant mouvement, vous anticipez les évolutions économiques, sociales, réglementaires et financières, en mesurez l'impact et préparez les propositions qui garantissent l'équilibre des régimes à long terme, notamment la fixation des taux de contribution.

Cette vision d'ensemble s'appuie sur une gestion financière rigoureuse : vous soumettez aux Conseils d'administration la stratégie de placement des réserves et en assurez la mise en œuvre, en direct ou avec des partenaires externes selon votre profil. Vous en exercez un suivi attentif, portant sur le reporting, la performance et le niveau de risque.

Vous assurez également le pilotage financier et administratif des Fonds, incluant la gestion des risques et du système de contrôle interne, le suivi budgétaire et comptable ainsi que la conformité aux dispositions législatives des organes d’exécution.

Interlocuteur·trice des Conseils d'administration, des autorités, des caisses de compensation et des acteurs financiers, vous représentez les Fonds et conduisez des dossiers complexes dans le respect des équilibres institutionnels. Vous contribuez en particulier activement, sous la conduite du DCS, à la mise en place des évolutions et nouveaux régimes attendus ces prochaines années (allocation de garde et assurance\-parentalité).

Pour mener à bien ces missions, vous pouvez compter sur une équipe de trois personnes, expérimentée et autonome, à la tête de laquelle vous veillez à maintenir une culture de confiance et de responsabilisation, tout en l'accompagnant dans les évolutions à venir.

**Votre profil**

* Formation supérieure de niveau Master en sciences économiques, droit, gestion ou administration publique, idéalement complétée par une formation en finance ou en assurances sociales.

* Solides compétences financières, vous permettant de gérer la fortune ou d'en superviser la gestion; une expérience en gestion de fortune constitue un atout.

* Leadership humain et responsabilisant, allié à du discernement, de la conviction, de l'intégrité et un sens marqué de l'intérêt général.
* Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles en français. L’allemand est un atout.

Access Excellence Director
==========================







For our Client, a large pharmaceutical company based in **Basel**, we are seeking an experienced **Access Excellence Director** to join the Value \& Access organization.



In this role, you will be responsible for driving operational excellence across international markets, enabling data\-driven decision\-making, and building best\-in\-class access performance management capabilities.



You will lead the development and execution of governance processes, KPI frameworks, analytics strategies, budgeting processes, and knowledge management initiatives that support high\-quality access outcomes across the organization. Acting as a key partner to Access, HEOR, Pricing, Finance, Analytics, and market teams, you will ensure consistent execution, strong performance visibility, and continuous improvement across the access function.



Key Responsibilities



* Drive operational excellence across the Value \& Access organization through robust governance, performance management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Own and evolve access governance processes, decision\-support systems, and the overall Access Excellence operating model.
* Develop and maintain enterprise\-wide access KPI frameworks and dashboards across pre\-launch, launch, post\-launch, and lifecycle management activities.
* Enable data\-driven decision\-making by delivering meaningful insights, analytics, and performance reporting to senior leadership.
* Define and implement access data standards, governance principles, quality controls, and reporting processes.
* Partner with IT, analytics teams, and markets to establish reliable data flows and ensure a single source of truth for access\-related data.
* Lead annual budgeting and financial planning activities across Access functions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities and effective resource allocation.
* Monitor budgets, evaluate investment decisions, and support trade\-off discussions through business\-focused analytics.
* Facilitate best\-practice sharing, capability building, and knowledge management across regions and markets.
* Collaborate effectively within a highly matrixed global environment, balancing diverse stakeholder needs while maintaining focus on business objectives.
* Ensure all activities comply with applicable ethics, risk, quality, and compliance requirements.


**Required**



* 8\+ years of experience in Market Access, Value \& Access, Access Operations, Operational Excellence, or related functions.
* International, regional, or global market experience.
* Proven experience designing and implementing KPI frameworks, dashboards, reporting systems, and governance processes.
* Strong understanding of access data, performance management systems, data governance, and analytics.
* Experience leading cross\-functional initiatives within complex matrix organizations.
* Experience with budget planning, tracking, and resource management.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.


**Preferred**



* Experience in a global pharmaceutical or biotechnology organization.
* Exposure to Access Excellence, Commercial Excellence, Market Access Operations, Pricing Operations, or related functions.
* MBA, PhD, MD, PharmD, or equivalent advanced degree.
* Extensive experience working across multiple international markets.


What You'll Bring



* Strategic mindset combined with strong operational execution capabilities.
* Ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
* Strong leadership and influencing skills without direct authority.
* Passion for continuous improvement and performance excellence.
* Enterprise mindset with the ability to build alignment across diverse stakeholders.
* Strong analytical capabilities and comfort working with complex datasets and performance metrics.

- Titulaire d'une formation professionnelle en cuisine de type CFC Cuisine, BAC Pro ou équivalent

title: Business Analyst
description:
GLOBAZ SA développe et héberge des solutions IT critiques pour des environnements exigeants en  
Suisse : prévoyance, santé, industrie et administrations. Nos activités impliquent un haut niveau de fiabilité,  
de sécurité, de qualité d’exécution et de responsabilité. L’entreprise est engagée dans une  
transformation importante de son organisation et de son niveau d’exécution.


Dans un contexte de structuration de notre Customer Journey, nous recherchons un(e) :



**Business Analyst**  

GLOBAZ SA est engagée dans une transformation ambitieuse de son modèle opérationnel, de sa culture et de sa relation client. Notre ambition : passer d'une logique de fournisseur de services à une logique de partenaire stratégique créateur de valeur.

Nos clients ne nous évaluent pas sur nos intentions. Ils nous évaluent sur la qualité de l'expérience vécue, notre capacité à comprendre leurs enjeux, notre proactivité et notre réactivité, notre capacité à résoudre leurs « irritations », et notre capacité à contribuer concrètement à leur succès.

Ce rôle clé contribue à améliorer concrètement l'expérience client, à réduire les frictions, à accélérer la résolution des « problèmes » et à renforcer durablement la valeur créée pour nos clients.

**Ton rôle**

Le Business Analyst recueille et analyse les besoins des clients, qu’il s’agisse d’identifier des faiblesses ou opportunités d’amélioration des processus métier, de faire évoluer les structures organisationnelles ou de répondre à des enjeux informatiques. Il les challenge, les formalise en exigences claires et structurées, puis identifie les différentes possibilités d’implémentation en solutions informatiques.

Il intervient notamment dans des projets de digitalisation et d’automatisation des processus métier, ainsi que dans des activités de maintenance et de développement de solutions logicielles.

Au quotidien, le Business Analyst travaille en étroite collaboration avec les Project Managers (PM), Product Owners (PO), équipes IT et parties prenantes métier. Il veille à créer une compréhension commune des besoins et à assurer le lien entre les attentes métier et leur traduction en solutions technologiques.

En résumé, le Business Analyst est un véritable facilitateur de la transformation : il comprend les enjeux, pose les bonnes questions, structure les besoins et contribue à transformer les idées en solutions à valeur ajoutée.

**Tes responsabilités**

***Comprendre et recueillir les besoins :***

* Définir le processus et les méthodes employées pour la récolte des besoins (ateliers, interview, event storming, etc…)
* Formaliser les besoins, les valider et les transcrire en exigences, les spécifier et les modéliser
* Cartographier et décrire les processus ainsi que les flux de valeurs


***Analyser et challenger les besoins** :*

* Analyser le fonctionnement global des processus métier, des structures d'organisation et des enjeux de l'informatique
* Analyser les besoins des parties prenantes internes et externes
* Documenter les besoins métiers au travers de spécifications et de maquettes (rédaction des cahiers des charges)
* Proposer des solutions informatiques et organisationnelles pour répondre aux besoins


***Accompagner la réalisation :***

* Rédiger les user stories et les critères d’acceptation, alimenter le backlog avec le Product Owner
* Participer aux cérémonies agiles et rester disponible pour les équipes de développement tout au long de la réalisation
* Contribuer à la définition des scénarios de test et vérifier la conformité des solutions livrées avec les besoins analysés


**Ton profil**

* Sensibilité technique : tu es à l’aise pour dialoguer avec les développeurs et tu comprends les enjeux d’une solution logicielle ; une formation ou une expérience dans l’informatique (développement, intégration, bases de données, API) est un plus
* Expérience de la méthodologie agile (user stories, backlog, tests d’acceptation)
* Connaissance des assurances sociales suisses (AVS/AI/APG, PC, allocations familiales, LAMal) et expérience avec des logiciels métier complexes : un atout majeur
* Orientation client : tu raisonnes succès et expérience client
* Orientation solutions : face à une difficulté, tu proposes des options plutôt que de remonter des problèmes ; tu es pragmatique et tu aimes faire avancer les choses
* Esprit d’équipe et aisance relationnelle : tu sais fédérer des interlocuteurs métier et techniques, animer des ateliers et coordonner des équipes pluridisciplinaires
* Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA) ou Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP) : un plus

title: Product Portfolio Senior Manager Education & Athletes Pathways
employer: Académie Internationale des Sciences et Techniques du Sport (AISTS)
description:
Postulation : https://www.jobup.ch/en/jobs/detail/b2dabcb5-de1a-49d7-870d-91c536ce96a7/?source=company_detail

Are you passionate about creating seamless experiences in education and sport? Are you sensitive to serving the
athletes and bringing them at the center of the sport ecosystem ?
Do you thrive in dynamic, multicultural environments?
Are you driven by developing projects and businesses?
Then join AISTS – the International Academy of Sports Management and Technology – and contribute to shaping
the future of sports leadership.
About AISTS
AISTS, the International Academy of Sport Management and Technology, is a prestigious not-for-profit academic
centre at the heart of the global sport industry. Founded in 2000 in Lausanne, Switzerland, it offers world-class
education and advisory services in sport management. AISTS's unique multidisciplinary approach combines
expertise in technology, management, economics, medicine, career and leadership. With a network of over 750
alumni, 100 distinguished lecturers, and partnerships with leading sport organisations, AISTS shapes the future of
international sport. Located in the Olympic Capital, it serves as a bridge between academia and industry, promoting
excellence in sport management to drive positive global impact through the power of sport.
Your role
The Product Portfolio Senior Manager is responsible for translating the AISTS portfolio strategy into a coherent,
prioritised and commercially viable product portfolio across three product areas: Education, Athletes Pathways, and
Advisory. It initially owns direct responsibility for both Education and Athletes Pathways products streams.
The role ensures that AISTS moves from a primarily MAS-centred organisation toward an integrated platform
combining industry access, short and tailored education, athlete-career transition solutions, and international sport
organisations advisory services (e.g. impact assessments, certification, research mandates, etc.).
Positioning & Context
Reporting to the Executive Director, you will work in partnership with the Professors, experts, speakers and partners
of the AISTS network. Internally, you will work closely with the Head of B2B Partnerships & Development and the
Head of Operations & Delivery. Initially, you will manage the Sport Advisory Product Coordinator.
This role is established as part of a new strategy adopted and rolled out by AISTS. The scope of the role may evolve
according to the deployment of the strategy.
Key responsibilities
Portfolio Management
• Own the consolidated product portfolio roadmap across Education, Athletes Pathways and Advisory.
• Establish common product management standards and coherence across products in terms of target
audiences, value propositions, pricing logic, delivery model, resource needs and expected contribution.
• Prioritise product development using mission alignment, market demand, revenue potential, profitability,
scalability, feasibility and strategic value.
• Translate strategic priorities into clear product briefs, annual product plans, performance indicators and
implementation milestones.
• Maintain product governance discipline, ensuring that each product has an owner, business case, delivery
model, quality criteria, review cycle and is aligned with B2B development (proposal development) and clearly
framed for the Operations and Delivery team to operate
• Provide the Executive Director with a consolidated view of product performance, portfolio risks,
dependencies and investment priorities.
Product ownership
1. Athlete Pathways
• Design and develop the AISTS Athletes Pathways offer, including education, transition, employability,
leadership, entrepreneurship and mentoring formats for active, retiring and retired athletes.
• Build the product value proposition for IFs, NOCs, Olympic stakeholders, athlete commissions, agencies,
sponsors and individual athletes.
• Coordinate athlete-specific curriculum development, mentor pools, career coaching components and
storytelling opportunities with alumni, industry experts and corporate partners.
• Track performance of the athlete pathway product, including athletes supported, revenues, scholarships,
partner satisfaction and post-programme outcomes.
2. Master of Advanced Studies in Sport Management and Technology (MAS) & Continued Education
programmes
• Coordinate curriculum architecture, learning formats, field visits, internships, Client Team Projects, research
papers and industry exposure to maintain and strengthen the leading positioning of the programme.
• Work with delivery coordinators and academic partners to ensure programme design is feasible, coherent
and quality-controlled.
• Lead on the design of the annual Continued Education portfolio across Sport Business, Sport Leadership and
Sport Technology, ensuring their relevance for market needs
• Define course value propositions, target segments, learning outcomes, course leaders, pricing logic and
annual calendar priorities.
• Source lecturers and guest speakers and, where relevant, supervise MAS Client Team Projects
3. Training Houses and tailored education solution
• Develop repeatable B2B education offers for sport organisations starting with IFs and then NOCs, NFs,
LOCs, etc.
• Package tailored education into clear formats, such as staff training, leadership journeys, member federation
modules, Olympic Capital Training Weeks and capability-building workshops ensuring balanced
customisation and reusability
4. Learning innovation and online support
• Use digital or online learning selectively to support continuity, blended formats, pre-work, follow-up modules
or scalable partner needs.
• Contribute to the development of reusable learning assets, templates, cases and content libraries when they
improve product quality and scalability.
• Coordinate with academic and industry stakeholders to keep education products relevant to emerging
trends such as digital, AI, sustainability, governance, fan engagement and commercial innovation.
Product team management
• Manage and coordinate the work with the product coordinator(s).
• Ensure that product owners work closely with Business Development and Marketing for market relevance,
positioning and partnerships and with Operations for delivery feasibility.
What we offer
• Dynamic Work Environment: Join an international team passionate about sports and education.
• Career Development: Gain exposure to a wide range of projects in a prestigious organisation.
• Inclusive Culture: We value diverse perspectives and actively encourage applications from all genders,
backgrounds, and experiences.
• Professional Growth: Access to training programmes to enhance your skills and career development.
• Mentorship Opportunities: Be part of a supportive team committed to helping you thrive in your role.
• Prime Location: Work in Lausanne, the Olympic Capital, with access to sports facilities and view on the
lake
Your skills and experience
• Experience:
o 8 years of experience, with minimum 3 years in continuing education programme design and/or
product development;
o Strong ability to bring strategy into product architecture, priorisation and execution plans;
o Business mindset, with ability to assess value propositions, pricing and financial contribution
without compromising AISTS quality and mission;
o Strong understanding of Olympic and international sport ecosystem, including trends and
challenges in the sport industry, and experience in working with / on elite-athletes related topics;
o Relevant network in the sport industry and international sport organisations a strong asset;
o Familiarity with Swiss higher education environment an asset;
• Technical Skills:
o Proficiency in MS Office 365; experience with e-learning, AI solutions, data management and CRM
an asset;
o Native-level fluency in English or French, with proficiency in the other language (3rd language is
a plus).
o Familiarity with AISTS activities and the MAS programme is highly valued;
o Experience related to sport (athlete, volunteer, coach or management) is highly valued;
• Personal Traits: Agile, flexible with ability to adapt in all situation, reliable, highly organised and at ease
with multitasking and service-oriented with strong communication skills in multicultural environments.
• Education: Master (MSc) degree in (Sport) Management and Business, Applied Sciences or Engineering
with a keen interest for human and athlete development.
What we expect
• Results driven, ability to sense priorities and client / service oriented.
• Dynamic personality with strong interpersonal skills.
• Ability to maintain a positive, pragmatic and open-minded attitude under stressful and operational
situations.
• Strong organisational, analytical, project and time management skills, with excellent attention to detail.
• Diplomacy, tact and discretion. Keen sense of confidentiality.
• Flexibility to work occasionally in the evenings and on weekends.
We welcome candidates from all professional backgrounds and encourage applications even if not all qualifications
are met. At AISTS, we value your potential.
How to Apply
We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and strongly encourage applications from women and men
equally. We particularly welcome candidates who bring diverse experiences and perspectives.
Send your CV, work certificates, and a cover letter (in English) outlining your motivation to join AISTS through the
platform jobup only. Deadline of application 11th of October 2026.
Starting Date: As soon as possible
Occupancy rate: full time, 100%
Location of work: Lausanne, Switzerland

title: Truck Racing and Historic Sporting Coordinator
description:
The Truck Racing and Historic Sporting Coordinator will contribute to the sporting, regulatory and operational delivery of the FIA Truck Racing and Historic Championships. The position is intended for a confirmed sporting coordination profile, capable of managing day-to-day championship matters with a high level of autonomy, while ensuring appropriate escalation and validation on regulatory, sporting and governance matters.

The role requires practical on-site experience, regular interaction with Race Control, Stewards, Race Directors, officials and teams, and the ability to distinguish between matters to be managed independently, matters to be prepared for validation, and matters to be performed under the authority of the relevant sporting decision-makers.

The indicative workload allocation is expected to be:
Truck Racing: 60%
Historic Championships: 40%

MISSIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
TRUCK RACING CHAMPIONSHIP SPORTING COORDINATION :
Coordinate the day-to-day sporting administration of the Truck Racing Championship, ensuring compliance with FIA requirements, sporting regulations and established procedures.
Manage the championship entry process and entry platform where applicable, including competitor support, document follow-up and deadline monitoring.
Review entry documentation and prepare any non-standard or eligibility-related matters for validation by the relevant Championship Manager or competent FIA body.
Coordinate routine communications with teams, ASNs, officials and internal FIA departments on sporting and operational matters.

HISTORIC CHAMPIONSHIPS SPORTING COORDINATION :
Coordinate day-to-day sporting and administrative matters related to Historic Championships, in liaison with the Historic Championships & Commission Manager.
Prepare sporting documents, procedures and information notes for review and validation by the relevant manager or governance body.
Follow up championship-related actions, regulatory updates and stakeholder requests.
Ensure proper coordination between Historic championship activities, commission work and FIA internal processes.

SPORTING DOCUMENTATION :
Prepare, review and maintain sporting documents for events and championships, including procedures, notes to competitors, operational guidelines and Stewards' Handbooks.
Ensure sporting documents remain aligned with current FIA regulations, championship requirements and operational practices.
Prepare draft amendments or updates for validation by the relevant Championship Manager and, where applicable, FIA governance bodies.
Coordinate the circulation of validated documents to the relevant internal and external stakeholders.

ON-SITE EVENT OPERATIONS AND RACE CONTROL SUPPORT

Race Control and Stewards support :
Support the Race Director and Race Control team during events, including preparation and coordination of operational procedures, messaging systems, radio communications, incident follow-up and parc fermé processes.
Prepare Race Control documentation, checklists and briefing materials in advance of events.
Assist the Stewards during events by coordinating administrative and operational processes, including official documentation, communication flows and distribution of decisions.
Prepare incident-related documentation or reports for review by the Race Director or Stewards, without substituting for their sporting decision-making authority.
Operate FIA onboard camera systems and retrieve footage when requested by the Race Director or Stewards for sporting or regulatory purposes.

Commission, committee and stakeholder coordination :
Attend meetings of the Truck Racing Commission, Historic Commission and related working groups as Sporting Coordinator.
Prepare agendas, working documents, meeting dossiers and follow-up notes for review and validation where required.
Maintain records of commission activities, recommendations and decisions.
Follow up action items resulting from commission meetings and coordinate with relevant FIA departments or stakeholders.
Escalate sensitive, strategic or policy-related matters to the relevant Championship Manager or Head of Racing & Historic.

Operational and administrative coordination :
Coordinate the operational needs of FIA staff on-site in relation to Truck Racing and Historic activities.
Support implementation of FIA sporting requirements during events.
Ensure effective preparation, follow-up and filing of sporting and operational documentation.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of sporting and operational processes within the scope of the role.

PROFILE:
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in motorsport sporting operations, championship coordination, race administration or equivalent.
Proven practical on-site experience and regular interaction with Race Control, Stewards, Race Directors, officials, teams and championship stakeholders.
Strong understanding of motorsport sporting regulations, event operations and regulatory processes.
Ability to work autonomously, manage priorities and identify matters requiring validation or escalation.
Strong organisational, drafting and communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear sporting and operational documentation.
Ability to work under pressure in an event environment and to interact professionally with officials, competitors and internal departments.
Fluent in English; French would be an advantage.
Available from December 2026.

Un.e éducateur/trice diplômé\-e à 80% en CDI
================================================







Déployée sur plusieurs sites, l'Institution de Lavigny est constituée d’un hôpital neurologique avec consultations ambulatoires sur deux sites, d’un département hébergement pour personnes adultes en situation de handicap, avec une déficience intellectuelle ou une problématique physique, d’une école spécialisée et d’un secteur ateliers et formation professionnelle.



Le département de l’école spécialisée « La Passerelle », accueille des enfants de 6 à 18 ans en difficulté d’apprentissage et de développement. Il assure un accompagnement global de l’enfant comprenant une formation scolaire, des interventions et suivis thérapeutiques et un suivi éducatif, avec possibilité d’hébergement de semaine et des temps d’accueil parascolaire. **Pour notre hébergement de semaine** qui accueille 14 jeunes en âge de scolarité, et **notre secteur** **parascolaire** nous cherchons :







Un.e éducateur/trice diplômé\-e à 80% en CDI
================================================



Dont la mission principale consistera à proposer un accompagnement éducatif aux enfants/adolescents, favorisant le lien entre la vie scolaire, les temps de loisirs et la vie de famille. L’activité se partage entre un accompagnement en hébergement de semaine et l’animation d’activités parascolaires (sports, devoirs, activités culturelles, etc.).



En étroite collaboration avec les familles et le réseau professionnel, vous contribuerez à l’élaboration et à la mise en œuvre d’un projet individualisé et adapté à chaque jeune, dans le cadre d’une intervention visant l’apprentissage de l’autonomie, l’autodétermination et qui s’appuie sur les ressources et les compétences des jeunes et de leurs familles.



En tant que personne expérimentée, à même de gérer des projets, vous saurez proposer des activités ludiques et épanouissantes, qu’elles soient groupales ou individuelles. Vous saurez mettre en perspective et en réflexion une approche systémique et pluridisciplinaire basée sur le respect de la responsabilité, de l’autonomie et de la vulnérabilité de chacun. Dynamique, communicateur, vous possédez un intérêt marqué pour le travail en équipe interdisciplinaire.



Les horaires de travail sont annualisés et se répartissent de 7 à 22h, du lundi midi au vendredi midi. Les services sont fermés pendant les vacances scolaires vaudoises.



**Nous demandons** :



* Un diplôme d’éducateur social ES ou HES reconnu,  
* Un permis de conduire valable,  
* Un intérêt prononcé pour le domaine de la pédagogie spécialisée et des troubles des apprentissages,  


**Nous offrons :**



* Une activité au sein d’une équipe dynamique et motivée, dans un cadre de travail agréable,  
* Un salaire en rapport avec la fonction et selon les normes du secteur parapublic vaudois,  
* Des possibilités de formation continue,  
* Les avantages sociaux d’une grande institution, restaurant, parking ou transports publics assurés depuis la gare de Morges.

Business Manager (w/m/d)

Über uns
---------







LGT ist eine führende internationale Private Banking und Asset Management Gruppe, die sich seit über 100 Jahren im Besitz der Fürstenfamilie von Liechtenstein befindet. Mit rund 600 Mitarbeitenden hat sich die LGT Bank Schweiz als namhafte Schweizer Privatbank etabliert und ist sowohl für vermögende Privatkunden wie auch für Mitarbeitende eine ausgezeichnete Adresse \- dies bestätigte im vergangenen Jahr auch das unabhängige Institut «Great Place To Work», welches die LGT Bank Schweiz als einer der besten Arbeitgeber in der Schweiz prämiert hat.

* Vorbereitung und Koordination von Managementsitzungen, Workshops, Offsites und Leadership Events, einschliesslich der Erstellung von Entscheidungsgrundlagen, Präsentationen, Berichten und Kernbotschaften für die Geschäftsleitung

* Koordination und Abstimmung mit relevanten Anspruchsgruppen sowie Sicherstellung einer transparenten und konsistenten Kommunikation und Umsetzung.

title: Strategic Account Manager Orthopaedics (Open)
description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more athttps://www.jnj.com/.



About Orthopaedics

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Are you passionate about improving and expanding the possibilities of Orthopaedics? Ready to join a team that’s reimagining how we heal? Our Orthopaedics teams help keep more than 6 million people moving each year while delivering clinical and economic value to surgeons and healthcare systems. Our teams build solutions for joint reconstruction; trauma and craniomaxillofacial; sports, extremities, and elective foot and ankle; spine; and robotics and digital surgery.

Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/medtech



Strategic Account Manager Orthopaedics - Johnson & Johnson

Western Part of Switzerland

Are you passionate about making a tangible difference in healthcare? Do you thrive on building strong relationships and driving growth? We are seeking a Senior Strategic Account Manager to join our sales team, drive market expansion, and deliver innovative surgical solutions to our customers. This role anchors Johnson & Johnson’s go-to-market strategy, emphasizing long-term partnerships and measurable value for patients. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to elevate customer outcomes and fuel sustainable business growth. If you’re a strategic thinker with a proven track record in key account management, we’d love to hear from you.



Responsibilities

Strategic Account Management is an essential part of the future business strategy for the Johnson & Johnson companies. It is how we will go to market as an Orthopaedics organization and will be critical to our future growth plans. With this approach to our non-clinical customers, we can demonstrate the long-term value of partnership and working with Johnson & Johnson, most importantly, our impact on patient care.

In the role as Strategic Account Manager you will report to the Lead of the Strategic Account Management for Orthopaedics and be responsible for developing mutually beneficial long-term partnerships with clinical and non-clinical partners in a given number of designated key accounts.

In conjunction with the Business Units, you will develop and lead the account strategy to drive additional profitable sales and market share growth within Hospital, Hospital Groups & Group Purchasing Organizations.

Together with the clinical team, you will coordinate and support the proposal development process, presenting opportunities and risks along with their implications to the required levels of management.

As key driver of our Value Based Health Care Strategy you will lead negotiations for commercial agreements and coordinate their execution across care centers, in collaboration with the Business Unit and Shared Functions (Pricing, Services & Solutions, HEMA, etc.).

You will be the representative of Johnson & Johnson Orthopaedics for the commercial partners in strategic accounts.



Qualifications

Master’s degree in Business Administration or relevant field is an advantage.

Several years of clinical experience in a Sales Manager or Key Account Manager role, with proven experience in managing non-clinical partnerships.

Deep understanding of the healthcare market and the local regulatory/policy environment; adept at identifying short-term and long-term factors impacting the business.

Experience in contract negotiations and deal structuring.

Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills in French to professionally represent Johnson & Johnson’s MedTech in the country; strong English skills (written and spoken) are required; proficiency in a second official language is preferred.

German language skills in writing and speaking are a plus.

Strong negotiation skills, high self-confidence, courage, and conviction.

Analytical and strategic thinker with solid business acumen.

Project management capabilities with the ability to lead complex initiatives involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.

Strong team spirit and collaborative mindset.



Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopaedics business to establish a standalone Orthopaedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 4 to 9 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals.

Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans.In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.

Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

This role is the foundation of Accelleron's new Advanced Analytics AI Center of Excellence. This role requires coding experience and handling of structured and unstructured data sets. This role transforms business challenges into data-driven solutions: identifying the right data, building and validating models, translating results into insights and measurable business value.



The Advanced Analytics AI CoE builds process-agnostic capability and acts as the expert partner to the process domain teams and business units that own the solutions. AI and machine-learning use case delivery
